analyzed: sa ca pratyayaḥ utpadya vinivartamānaḥ sva āśraye pratyayini saṃskāram ādadhāti sa ca saṃskāraḥ kāraṇa anuvidhāyi tvāt ubhayāpāta kāraḥ eva sva vyañjaka añjanaḥ iti saṃskāra ādhyinaḥ pratyayasya hetu bhūtam yat karma datta phalam tat tulya jātīyam yat karma antaram phala pradānāya abhimukhībhavati tat sva vyañjakam

original: tathā ca vakṣyati tatas tadvipākānuguṇānām evābhivyaktir vāsanānam iti tatkarma pratyupanītaṃ vā sādṛśyapraṇidhānādi| svena vyañjakenābhivyajyata iti svavyañjakāñjanaḥ| grāhyagrahaṇātmikāṃ smṛtiṃ janayati| anyathā tadvyañjakasya karmaṇo vipākānupapattiḥ||

original: [54,18] te hi trīṇi bandhanāni prākṛtavaikṛtadākṣiṇāni samyagdarśanena hitvā kaivalyaṃ prāptāḥ| īśvarasya tu tatsaṃbandhaḥ kleśādisambandho na bhūto yathā muktasya pūrvā bandhakoṭer muktvopapatter eva jñāyate| bandhapūrvikā hi kuktiḥ| nāpi bhāvī| yathā prakṛtilīnasya| tasya hy anārabdhasaṃsārasya^ uttarā bandhakoṭiḥ sambhāvyate|
analyzed: te hi trīṇi bandhanāni prākṛta vaikṛta dākṣiṇāni samyak darśanena hitvā kaivalyam prāptāḥ īśvarasya tu tad saṃbandhaḥ kleśa ādi sambandhaḥ na bhūtaḥ yathā muktasya pūrvā bandha koṭeḥ muktvā upapatteḥ eva jñāyate bandha pūrvikā hi kuktiḥ na api bhāvī yathā prakṛti līnasya tasya hi anārabdha saṃsārasya uttarā bandha koṭiḥ sambhāvyate

original: pravṛttasaṃsārasya cāprakṛtilīnacittasya sā(samā)adhikāratvāt pūrvottarabandhakoṭī sambhavataḥ| tad idaṃ sarvam atrāparāmṛṣṭa^ iti kālāvivakṣāpradarśanārtham| sa tu sadā^ eva muktaḥ sadā^ eva-īśvaraḥ||
analyzed: pravṛtta saṃsārasya ca aprakṛti līna cittasya sā asamā adhikāra tvāt pūrva uttara bandha koṭī sambhavataḥ tat idam sarvam atra aparāmṛṣṭaḥ iti kāla avivakṣā pradarśana artham sa tu sadā eva muktaḥ sadā eva īśvaraḥ

original: [54,25] tatra puruṣaviśeṣa^ īśvara^ ity uktatvāt īśvarasya
analyzed: tatra puruṣa viśeṣaḥ īśvaraḥ iti ukta tvāt īśvarasya

original: puruṣasyānaiśvaryadharmatvāt cittasya caiśvaryadharmatvāt niratiśayaiśvaryasya ca prakṛṣṭacittasambandhāpekṣatvāt prāptam evottarārtham anuvadati yo śau prakṛṣṭasattvopādānād īśvarasya śāśvatika^ utkarṣa^ iti| nityaniratiśayasarvajñānāiśvaryaśaktisampattir utkarṣaḥ||
analyzed: puruṣasya anaiśvarya dharma tvāt cittasya ca aiśvarya dharma tvāt niratiśaya aiśvaryasya ca prakṛṣṭa citta sambandha apekṣa tvāt prāptam eva uttara artham anuvadati prakṛṣṭa sattva upādānāt īśvarasya śāśvatikaḥ utkarṣaḥ iti nitya niratiśaya sarvajñāna aiśvarya śakti sampattiḥ utkarṣaḥ

original: [55,4] tatra pratijñāviśuddhyarthaṃ praśnapūrvam upakramate sa kiṃ sanimitta^ āhosvin nirnimitta^ iti| nimittaśabdaḥ kāraṇaparyāyaḥ| sa kiṃ sakāraṇa^ āhosmin niṣkāraṇa^ iti| kiñcātaḥ yadi tāvat sakāraṇas tadā sadā^ eva-īśvara^ ity ayuktam anityatvāt| atha niṣkāraṇaḥ tathā ca^ utkarṣasya kāryatvād asattvaprasaṅgaḥ|
analyzed: tatra pratijñā viśuddhi artham praśna pūrvam upakramate sa kim sa nimittaḥ āhosvit nirnimittaḥ iti nimitta śabdaḥ kāraṇa paryāyaḥ sa kim sa kāraṇaḥ āhosmin niṣkāraṇaḥ iti kiñca atas yadi tāvat sa kāraṇaḥ tadā sadā eva īśvaraḥ iti ayuktam anitya tvāt atha niṣkāraṇaḥ tathā ca utkarṣasya kārya tvāt asattva prasaṅgaḥ

original: na hi niṣkāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ dṛśyate loke||
analyzed: na hi niṣkāraṇam kāryam dṛśyate loke

original: atrocyate na niṣkāraṇaḥ śāstranimittatvāt| śāstraṃ jñānam| śāstrasya hetutvāt| yataḥ satvaviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ nityaṃ dravyasvabhāvasādhyasādhanavyavahitaviprakṛṣṭāspadam||
analyzed: atrā ucyate na niṣkāraṇaḥ śāstra nimitta tvāt śāstram jñānam śāstrasya hetu tvāt yatas satva viṣayam jñānam nityam dravya svabhāva sādhya sādhana vyavahita viprakṛṣṭa āspadam

original: [55,12] yady evaṃ jñānasyānyato 'dhigamapūrvatvāt prāg anutkarṣaḥ prāpta^ ity ata^ āha śāstraṃ punaḥ kiṃ-nimittam iti| yadi svābhāvikaṃ jñānaṃ mattonmattajñānavad anutkarṣahetutvam| atha punaḥ sanimittakaṃ nimittāt prāg anutkarṣa^ iti manyate ||
analyzed: yadi evam jñānasya anyatas dhigama pūrva tvāt prāk anutkarṣaḥ prāptaḥ iti atas āha śāstram punar kiṃnimittam iti yadi svābhāvikam jñānam matta unmatta jñāna vat anutkarṣa hetu tvam atha punar sa nimittakam nimittāt prāk anutkarṣaḥ iti manyate

original: [55,15] na tāvan nirnimittam| yataḥ prakṛṣṭasattvanimittaṃ prakṛṣṭasattvāśrayam iti yāvat| ata^ eva svabhāvajñānadoṣābhāvaḥ||
analyzed: na tāvat nirnimittam yatas prakṛṣṭa sattva nimittam prakṛṣṭa sattva āśrayam iti yāvat atas eva svabhāva jñāna doṣa abhāvaḥ

original: [55,17] kiñ ca svābhāvikajñānatve api na mattādijñānavad apakarṣahetutvam| nityamuktakleśādisattvāśrayatvāt| tatra yathā^ eva jñānasaṃskārasmṛtiprabandhānām anyonyanimittanaimittikabhāvena bījāṅkurvad anādisaṃbandhaḥ tathā^ eva śāstraprakarṣayor īśvaracetasi nityapravṛttaprabandharūpeṇa pravartamānayor anādyantaḥ saṃbandhaḥ|
analyzed: kiñ ca svābhāvika jñāna tve api na matta ādi jñāna vat apakarṣa hetu tvam nitya mukta kleśa ādi sattva āśraya tvāt tatra yathā eva jñāna saṃskāra smṛti prabandhānām anyonya nimitta naimittika bhāvena bīja aṅkur vat anādi saṃbandhaḥ tathā eva śāstra prakarṣayoḥ īśvara cetasi nitya pravṛtta prabandha rūpeṇa pravartamānayoḥ anādi antaḥ saṃbandhaḥ

original: tatrotkarṣo jñanasya kāryam eva jjānam api tasya kāraṇam eva||
analyzed: tatra utkarṣaḥ jñanasya kāryam eva api tasya kāraṇam eva

original: [55,22] anyeṣāṃ vyākhyānam nimittaśabdaḥ pramāṇavācī| tasya śāstraṃ nimittaṃ pramāṇam tena hi tadutkarṣaḥ pramīyate| śāstraṃ punaḥ kiṃpramāṇakam īśvaranirmalasattvapramāṇam| viśuddhasattvapraṇītatvād dhi śāstrasya prāmāṇyam yathā manvādīnām| tathā ca śrutiḥ yakiṃcinmanur abhyavadat tad bheṣajam iti yathā ca loke guruṇā 'bhihitam iti||
analyzed: anyeṣām vyākhyānam nimitta śabdaḥ pramāṇa vācī tasya śāstram nimittam pramāṇam tena hi tad utkarṣaḥ pramīyate śāstram punar kiṃpramāṇakam īśvara nirmala sattva pramāṇam viśuddha sattva praṇīta tvāt hi śāstrasya prāmāṇyam yathā manu ādīnām tathā ca śrutiḥ yat kiṃcid manuḥ abhyavadat tat bheṣajam iti yathā ca loke guruṇā bhihitam iti

original: [56,8] etayoḥ śāstrotkarṣayoḥ pramāṇaprameyatayā nirādyantaḥ sambandhaḥ||
analyzed: etayoḥ śāstra utkarṣayoḥ pramāṇa prameya tayā nirādi antaḥ sambandhaḥ

original: [56,9] nanu ca naiva-īśvarasattve [ā]vartamānena śāstreṇacitta tadutkarṣaḥ
analyzed: nanu ca na eva īśvara sattve āvartamānena tad utkarṣaḥ

original: pramīyate| na^ eṣa doṣaḥ| tat-prabhavatvāt tatra vartamānam| varta(māna)ta eva tat-prabhavam api śāstraṃ tasmin sarvajñatvād eva| loke api yato yat prabhavati vartate tat tasmin yathā tantvādiṣu paṭādi| tat prabhavatvam anumānāgamābhyām avagamyate|
analyzed: pramīyate na eṣa doṣaḥ tad prabhava tvāt tatra vartamānam vartamānataḥ eva tad prabhavam api śāstram tasmin sarvajña tvāt eva loke api yatas yat prabhavati vartate tat tasmin yathā tantu ādiṣu paṭa ādi tat prabhava tvam anumāna āgamābhyām avagamyate

original: śāstrapramāṇakaḥ utkarṣaḥ īśvarapramāṇakaṃ śāstram iti bhinnāśrayatvāc chāstrotkarṣayor netaretarāśrayatvam||
analyzed: śāstra pramāṇakaḥ utkarṣaḥ īśvara pramāṇakam śāstram iti bhinna āśraya tvāt śāstra utkarṣayoḥ na itaretara āśraya tvam

original: [56,14] nanu ca śāstrād īśvaraprāmāṇyaṃ tat prāmāṇyāc ca śāstraprāmāṇyam iti syād anyonyāśrayatvam usyate^ īśvaraprāmāṇyasyānumānena siddhatvād adoṣaḥ||
analyzed: nanu ca śāstrāt īśvara prāmāṇyam tat prāmāṇyāt ca śāstra prāmāṇyam iti syāt anyonya āśraya tvam usyate īśvara prāmāṇyasya anumānena siddha tvāt adoṣaḥ

original: [56,16] etasmād etad bhavati| kasmāt īśvaraprakṛṣṭasattvāśrayayor niratiśayajñānotkarṣayoḥ kāryakāraṇarūpe prabandhanityayayā nityatvād etad bhavati sa tu sadā^ eva muktaḥ sadā^ eva-īśvara^ iti| (ity atrāha) tac ca tasyaiśvaryaṃ sāmyātiśayavimuktam iti vakṣyamāṇapramāṇaphalam| etatsūtrapiṇḍārtho vā||
analyzed: etasmāt etat bhavati kasmāt īśvara prakṛṣṭa sattva āśrayayoḥ niratiśaya jñāna utkarṣayoḥ kārya kāraṇa rūpe nitya tvāt etat bhavati sa tu sadā eva muktaḥ sadā eva īśvaraḥ iti iti atra āha tat ca tasya aiśvaryam sāmya atiśaya vimuktam iti vakṣyamāṇa pramāṇa phalam etad sūtra piṇḍa arthaḥ vā

original: [56,20] atiśayavimuktatāṃ vyācaṣṭe na tāvad aiśvaryāntareṇā tadatiśayyate| kutaḥ yad^ evaiśvaryāntaraṃ tadatiśayānaṃ manyase tad eva ta aiśvaryaṃ mayā 'bhihitam| yatraivaiśvaryāntarātiśayi bhavaty aiśvaryaṃ sa^ eva^ īśvara^ iti yāvat| na ca tatsamānam aiśvaryam asti| samāndadharmaprakarṣāsaṃbhavāt||
analyzed: atiśaya vimukta tām vyācaṣṭe na tāvat aiśvarya antareṇa tat atiśayyate kutas yat eva aiśvarya antaram tat atiśayānam manyase tat eva te aiśvaryam mayā bhihitam yatra eva aiśvarya antara atiśayi bhavati aiśvaryam saḥ eva īśvaraḥ iti yāvat na ca tad samānam aiśvaryam asti samānda dharma prakarṣa asaṃbhavāt

original: [56,24] na hy ekasmin rājye dvayoḥ sabhavo rājñoḥ| ekasya vā dve rājye| tathā pratipādayati tad-dvayos tulyatvaṃ prasaktam| na hy ekasyānyataratra
analyzed: na hi ekasmin rājye dvayoḥ sabhavaḥ rājñoḥ ekasya vā dve rājye tathā pratipādayati tad dvayoḥ tulya tvam prasaktam na hi ekasya anyataratra

original: prākāmyam abādhitvā^ anyatarasmin pravṛttir upapadyate| dvayoś ca yugapad ekārthayor ekasya prākāmyeṇa pravṛttir eva nāsti| prakāmite vastuni samānaprakarṣasyārthasya viruddhatvāt| yena ca samānaprakarṣatā tasya tena^ eva sa bādhyate| (te ca) tac ca na vācā bādhanam itarasya rūpātiśayā^ āvṛttyatiśayāś ca viruddhyante|
analyzed: prākāmyam a bādhitvā anyatarasmin pravṛttiḥ upapadyate dvayoḥ ca yugapad eka arthayoḥ ekasya prākāmyeṇa pravṛttiḥ eva na asti prakāmite vastuni samāna prakarṣasya arthasya viruddha tvāt yena ca samāna prakarṣa tā tasya tena eva sa bādhyate te ca tat ca na vācā bādhanam itarasya rūpa atiśayāḥ āvṛtti atiśayāḥ ca viruddhyante

original: sāmānyāni tv atiśayaiḥ saha vartanta^ iti vakṣyāmaḥ||
analyzed: sāmānyāni tu atiśayaiḥ saha vartante iti vakṣyāmaḥ

original: [57,13] tasmād yasya sāmyātiśayaviproṣitam aiśvaryaṃ sa^ īśvara^ iti
analyzed: tasmāt yasya sāmya atiśaya viproṣitam aiśvaryam saḥ īśvaraḥ iti

original: pradhānapuruṣavyatiriktaḥ pūruṣaviśeṣa^ īśvaraḥ siddhaḥ||1.24||
analyzed: pradhāna puruṣa vyatiriktaḥ pūruṣa viśeṣaḥ īśvaraḥ siddhaḥ

original: [57,15] yathāpratijñātasya-īśvarasya siddhau pramāṇam upanyasyate tatra niratiśayaṃ sarvajñabījam| tatra tasmin yathāpratijñātalakṣaṇa^ īśvare niratiśayaṃ bhavitum arhati| kiṃ tad iti yad^ idam avyabhicāri
analyzed: yathāpratijñātasya īśvarasya siddhau pramāṇam upanyasyate tatra niratiśayam sarvajña bījam tatra tasmin yathāpratijñāta lakṣaṇe īśvare niratiśayam bhavitum arhati kim tat iti yat idam avyabhicāri

original: pratyakṣānumānajñānam atītaviṣayaṃ anāgataviṣayaṃ(vartamānakāla)pratyutpanna[viṣaya]m atītādisamuccayaviṣayam atīndriyaviṣayaṃ ca| atīndriyayor atītānāgatayoḥ saṃbhavād atīndriya[grahaṇa]m ity ucyate||
analyzed: pratyakṣa anumāna jñānam atīta viṣayam anāgata viṣayam vartamāna kāla pratyutpanna viṣayam atīta ādi samuccaya viṣayam atīndriya viṣayam ca atīndriyayoḥ atīta anāgatayoḥ saṃbhavāt atīndriya grahaṇam iti ucyate

original: [57,20] tac cātīndriyagrahaṇaṃ trividham sūkṣmaviṣayaṃ vyavahitaviṣayaṃ viprakṛṣṭaviṣayañ ca| alpaṃ bahv iti| yathāprasiddham etad vivardhamānaṃ sātiśayatvena sarvajñabījaṃ yathā dhūmavijñānam agnivijñānasya| katham yatra prakarṣakāṣṭhāṃ pratipadyate| jñānasya jñātrāśrayatvāt yatreti jñātā^ ucyate yasmin jñātarīti| sa sarvajñaḥ siddhaḥ||
analyzed: tat ca atīndriya grahaṇam trividham sūkṣma viṣayam vyavahita viṣayam viprakṛṣṭa viṣayam ca alpam bahu iti yathā prasiddham etat vivardhamānam sa atiśaya tvena sarvajña bījam yathā dhūma vijñānam agni vijñānasya katham yatra prakarṣa kāṣṭhām pratipadyate jñānasya jñātṛ āśraya tvāt yatra iti jñātā ucyate yasmin jñātari iti sa sarvajñaḥ siddhaḥ

original: [57,24] tathā śaktir api sātiśayatvena vivardhamānā yatra kāṣṭhāṃ prāpnoti sa sarvaśaktiḥ| tena jagannirmāṇasthāpanopasaṃhārādikartṛtvasiddhiḥ| tathaiśvaryasyāpi vardhamānasya yatra kāṣṭhāprāptiḥ sa parama-īśvaraḥ| tataś cāśaktyādiviparyayadoṣābhāvasiddhiḥ||
analyzed: tathā śaktiḥ api sātiśaya tvena vivardhamānā yatra kāṣṭhām prāpnoti sa sarva śaktiḥ tena jagat nirmāṇa sthāpana upasaṃhāra ādi kartṛ tva siddhiḥ tathā aiśvaryasya api vardhamānasya yatra kāṣṭhā prāptiḥ sa parama īśvaraḥ tatas ca aśakti ādi viparyaya doṣa abhāva siddhiḥ

original: [58,1] athāpi syāt ajñānasyāpi vivardhamānasya svabhāvasiddhasya kāṣṭhāprāptasya tasminn īśvare siddhir iti na jñānavirodhāt| na hi jñānājñānayor viruddhayor ekasminn abhisaṃyogo 'sti| na hi jñāne
analyzed: atha api syāt ajñānasya api vivardhamānasya svabhāva siddhasya kāṣṭhā prāptasya tasmin īśvare siddhiḥ iti na jñāna virodhāt na hi jñāna ajñānayoḥ viruddhayoḥ ekasmin abhisaṃyogaḥ sti na hi jñāne

original: prakarṣavati tatrājñānaṃ saṃbhavati||
analyzed: prakarṣavati tatra ajñānam saṃbhavati

original: [58,4] yatra hi jyotir vivardhate tatra tamo 'pakṛṣyata^ eva| viparyayo 'pīti cet tac ca na sati jyotiṣi tamaso 'nupalambhāt| vidyamānaṃ hi tamo jyotiṣā tiraskriyate na kadācid vidyamānaṃ jyotis tamasā 'abhibhūyate||
analyzed: yatra hi jyotiḥ vivardhate tatra tamā upakṛṣyate eva viparyayaḥ pi iti ced tat ca na sati jyotiṣi tamasaḥ n upalambhāt vidyamānam hi tamaḥ jyotiṣā tiraskriyate na kadācid vidyamānam jyotiḥ tamasā abhibhūyate

original: [58,7] yad^ api jaladharoparodhāt prāvṛṣi sveradarśanam tad api dṛṣṭavyavadhānamātram| na punaḥ prakāśa^ eva torodhīyate tamovat| tasmānnityā na yatra jñānavivṛddhis tatrājñānasya bhāvaḥ samitarīva tamasaḥ| nityātyantatirohitarajas-tamo-guṇasattvopādānāt||
analyzed: yat api jaladhara uparodhāt prāvṛṣi svera darśanam tat api dṛṣṭa vyavadhāna mātram na punar prakāśaḥ eva torodhīyate tamaḥ vat tasmāt nityā na yatra jñāna vivṛddhiḥ tatra ajñānasya bhāvaḥ samitari iva tamasaḥ nitya atyanta tirohita rajaḥ tamaḥ guṇa sattva upādānāt

original: [58,10] kiñ ca nājñānasyāvastuviṣayatvād vivṛddhiḥ saṃbhavati| jñānasya jñeyavastuviṣayatvād abhivṛddhyupapattiḥ| ajñānasya hi vastuviṣayatve jñānatvaprāptiḥ||
analyzed: kim ca na ajñānasya avastu viṣaya tvāt vivṛddhiḥ saṃbhavati jñānasya jñeya vastu viṣaya tvāt abhivṛddhi upapattiḥ ajñānasya hi vastu viṣaya tve jñāna tva prāptiḥ

original: [58,12] yaś cāpi sthāvarādhiśv ajñānaprakarṣa^ iti nāsau prakarṣaḥ| atyantajñānābhāvāpekṣayā hi sa^ ucyate.ajñānasya prakarṣe hi saty ajñānasahasrasya na jñānena^ekena bādhaḥ syāt| tathā[dā] hi pratyajñānaṃ jñānentpannenānekena bādhanaṃ syāt| tasmānnityā nājñānasya prakarṣaḥ sverūpeṇa||
analyzed: yaḥ ca api ajñāna prakarṣaḥ iti na asau prakarṣaḥ atyanta jñāna abhāva apekṣayā hi saḥ ucyate ajñānasya prakarṣe hi sati ajñāna sahasrasya na jñānena ekena bādhaḥ syāt hi prati ajñānam bādhanam syāt tasmāt nityāḥ na ajñānasya prakarṣaḥ sverūpeṇa

original: [58,16] yasya hi sātiśayatvaṃ tasya kāṣṭhāprāptir dṛśyate| yathā
analyzed: yasya hi sa atiśaya tvam tasya kāṣṭhā prāptiḥ dṛśyate yathā

original: phalādiparimāṇānām ākāśaparyantatā| tathā sarvajñabījam api parāṃ kāṣṭhāṃ prāptum arhati||
analyzed: phala ādi parimāṇānām ākāśa paryanta tā tathā sarvajña bījam api parām kāṣṭhām prāptum arhati

original: [58,18] samastaṃ vyastaṃ ca sarvaṃ vastu-jātam ekasya pratyakṣaṃ jñeyatvāt ghaṭādivat||
analyzed: samastam vyastam ca sarvam vastu jātam ekasya pratyakṣam jñeya tvāt ghaṭa ādi vat

original: [58,19] jñānaviṣayatvena puruṣārthatvāt ghaṭādivad eva||
analyzed: jñāna viṣaya tvena puruṣa artha tvāt ghaṭa ādi vat eva

original: [58,20] utpattimatī ca pṛthivī sāvayavatvāt ghaṭādivat||

analyzed: nanu ca śabda anitya tva pakṣe katham anitye sambandhani nityaḥ sambandhaḥ iti na hi anityayoḥ ajju ghaṭayoḥ sambandhaḥ syāt ucyate yathā pramāṇa prameyayoḥ indriya viṣayayoḥ ca kriyā kārakāṇām sambandhaḥ sthitaḥ eva anityeṣu api sambandhiṣu tadvat atra api sthitaḥ eva avyabhicāreṇa sambandhaḥ sarga ādiṣu api vācya vācaka śakti apekṣaḥ saṅketaḥ

original: [115,17] tathānumānaṃ sāmānyaviṣayam eva| tad apy uktam eva sāmānyāvadhāraṇapradhānā vṛttih iti tathodāharaṇena ca pratipāditam yatra
analyzed: tathā anumānam sāmānya viṣayam eva tat api uktam eva sāmānya avadhāraṇa pradhānā vṛttiḥ iti tathā udāharaṇena ca pratipāditam yatra

original: prāptis tatra gatiḥ| yatrāprāptis tatra na bhavati gatiḥ ity anumānena sāmānyopasaṃhāraḥ| sā mānyamātram anumānena^ upasaṃhriyate  tasmāc chrutānumānaviññānaviṣayo na viśeṣaḥ kaścid asti||
analyzed: prāptiḥ tatra gatiḥ yatra aprāptiḥ tatra na bhavati gatiḥ iti anumānena sāmānya upasaṃhāraḥ sā mānya mātram anumānena upasaṃhriyate tasmāt śruta anumāna viññāna viṣayaḥ na viśeṣaḥ kaścid asti

original: [115,22] yady evaṃ na lokapratyakṣeṇāpareṇa bhūtasūkṣmagataḥ puruṣagato vā viśeṣaḥ prajñāyeta| nānyac ca pramāṇatrayavyatiriktaṃ pramāṇam asti yena tadviśeṣaṃ sañjānīmahe^ iti ced āha na cāsya sūkṣmavyavahitaviprakṛṣṭasya vastuno lokapratyakṣeṇa grahaṇam| na cāsya viśeṣasyāpramāṇakasyābhāo 'stīti|
analyzed: yadi evam na loka pratyakṣeṇa apareṇa bhūta sūkṣma gataḥ puruṣa gataḥ vā viśeṣaḥ prajñāyeta na anyat ca pramāṇa traya vyatiriktam pramāṇam asti yena tad viśeṣam sañjānīmahe iti ced āha na ca asya sūkṣma vyavahita viprakṛṣṭasya vastunaḥ loka pratyakṣeṇa grahaṇam na ca asya viśeṣasya apramāṇakasya abhāvaḥ sti iti

original: pramāṇāvagamyamānarūpo hi bhāvo 'sti rājavīthīm adhirohati| tasmāt samādhiprajñānirgrāhya^ eva viśeṣo bhavati bhūtasūkṣmagataḥ puruṣagato vā||
analyzed: pramāṇa avagamyamāna rūpaḥ hi rāja vīthīm adhirohati tasmāt samādhi prajñā nirgrāhyaḥ eva viśeṣaḥ bhavati bhūta sūkṣma gataḥ puruṣa gataḥ vā

original: [116,13] nanu ca te sūkṣmagatā viśeṣāḥ pratyakṣeṇāvagamyante^ iti kim īśvaraññāpitam vastutvād avagamyanta^ iti cet āgamānumānābhyāṃ santīty avagamyanta^ eva| na ca niyāmakaṃ kiṃcid asti pratyakṣeṇa^ eva nirgrāhyā iti| na hi viśeṣā hastatalagatā^ api sarve gṛhyante na anyavastugataviśeṣāṇāṃ pratyakṣagrāhyatvasyānumeyatvāt||
analyzed: nanu ca te sūkṣma gatāḥ viśeṣāḥ pratyakṣeṇa avagamyante iti kim īśvara ñāpitam vastu tvāt avagamyante iti ced āgama anumānābhyām santi iti avagamyante eva na ca niyāmakam kiṃcid asti pratyakṣeṇa eva nirgrāhyāḥ iti na hi viśeṣāḥ hasta tala gatāḥ api sarve gṛhyante na anya vastu gata viśeṣāṇām pratyakṣa grāhya tvasya anumeya tvāt

original: [116,17] katham evaṃ manyate bhūtasūkṣmādgatā viśeṣāḥ pratyakṣagrāhyāḥ kasya cit kāryavastuviśeṣatvāt gṛhyamāṇasvapāṇigataviśeṣavad iti| tasmāc chrutānumānaprajñābhyām anyaviṣayā sā prajñā viśeṣārthatvād iti| viśeṣārthā hi sā||1.49||
analyzed: katham evam manyate bhūta sūkṣmāt gatāḥ viśeṣāḥ pratyakṣa grāhyāḥ kasya cid kārya vastu viśeṣa tvāt gṛhyamāṇa sva pāṇi gata viśeṣa vat iti tasmāt śruta anumāna prajñābhyām anya viṣayā sā prajñā viśeṣa artha tvāt iti viśeṣa arthā hi sā

original: [116,20] samādhiprajñāpratilambhe yoginaḥ prajñākṛtaḥ saṃskāro navo jāyate| prajñā hi saṃskārārambhiṇīti siddham| prajñābhinavbatvāt tatsaṃskāraḥ pratyagrataro jñyate^ iti viśeṣaḥ| prajñānavatvaṃ tu tasyā (sāmānya)anyaviṣayatvāt|
analyzed: samādhi prajñā pratilambhe yoginaḥ prajñā kṛtaḥ saṃskāraḥ navaḥ jāyate prajñā hi saṃskāra ārambhiṇī iti siddham prajñā abhinavba tvāt tad saṃskāraḥ pratyagrataraḥ jñyate iti viśeṣaḥ prajñānava tvam tu sāmānya anya viṣaya tvāt

original: taj-jassaṃskāro'nyasaṃskārapratibandhī ṛtumbharaprajñāprabhavasaṃskāro vyutthānasaṃskārāśayaṃ anyaṃ bādhate viśiṣṭyarthārthaviṣayaprabhavatvāt pratibandhnāti| ā mokṣāc cheta iti saṃskārāśayaḥ||
analyzed: tad jaḥ saṃskāraḥ anya saṃskāra pratibandhī ṛtumbhara prajñā prabhava saṃskāraḥ vyutthāna saṃskāra āśayam anyam bādhate viśiṣṭi artha artha viṣaya prabhava tvāt pratibandhnāti ā mokṣāt śete iti saṃskāra āśayaḥ

original: [116,26] vyutthānasaṃskārābhibhavāt vyutthānasaṃskārāśayasya samadhiprajñāsaṃskāreṇābhibhavāt tat-prabhavāḥ vyutthānasaṃskāraprabhavāḥ
analyzed: vyutthāna saṃskāra abhibhavāt vyutthāna saṃskāra āśayasya samadhi prajñā saṃskāreṇa abhibhavāt tad prabhavāḥ vyutthāna saṃskāra prabhavāḥ

original: pratyayā na bhavanti| pratyayanirodhe vyutthānapratyayanirodhe samādhiḥ samprajñāta^ iva^ upatiṣṭhate| tataḥ samādhijā prajñā tataḥ prajñākṛtaḥ saṃskārā iti^ evaṃ navaḥ saṃskārāśayo vardhate| tataś ca prajñā tataś ca saṃskārā iti||
analyzed: pratyayāḥ na bhavanti pratyaya nirodhe vyutthāna pratyaya nirodhe samādhiḥ samprajñātaḥ iva upatiṣṭhate tatas samādhi jā prajñā tatas prajñā kṛtaḥ saṃskārāḥ iti evam navaḥ saṃskāra āśayaḥ vardhate tatas ca prajñā tatas ca saṃskārāḥ iti

original: [117,12] atrāha samādhiprajñābhavaḥ saṃskārāśayaś cittasyādhikārapravṛttihetuḥ pratyayaprabhavatāt vyutthānaprabhavasaṃskārāśayavad iti tathā cittasaṃskāratvāc ceti| tad etad darśayati katham asau saṃskārāśayaḥ cittaṃ sādhikāraṃ saṃskāropetaṃ na kariṣyato^ iti||
analyzed: atra āha samādhi prajñā bhavaḥ saṃskāra āśayaḥ cittasya adhikāra pravṛtti hetuḥ pratyaya prabhava tāt vyutthāna prabhava saṃskāra āśaya vat iti tathā citta saṃskāra tvāt ca iti tat etat darśayati katham asau saṃskāra āśayaḥ cittam sa adhikāram saṃskāra upetam na kariṣyataḥ iti

original: [117,16] na^ eṣa doṣaḥ tadviroshitvāt| kathaṃ te saṃskārāḥ kleśakṣayahetutvāc cittam adhikāraviśiṣṭaṃ na kurvanti| vyutthānapratyayaprabhavānāṃ hi saṃskārāṇām avidyādikleśahetutvāc cittasaṃskārābhimukhabhāvakāraṇatā| tadvirodhipratyayaprabhavatvāt tu na samādhijapratyayajanmanāṃ saṃskārāṇām adhikārābhimukhyanimittatā||
analyzed: na eṣa doṣaḥ tad viroshi tvāt katham te saṃskārāḥ kleśa kṣaya hetu tvāt cittam adhikāra viśiṣṭam na kurvanti vyutthāna pratyaya prabhavānām hi saṃskārāṇām avidyā ādi kleśa hetu tvāt citta saṃskāra abhimukha bhāva kāraṇa tā tad virodhi pratyaya prabhava tvāt tu na samādhi ja pratyaya janmanām saṃskārāṇām adhikāra ābhimukhya nimitta tā

original: [117,20] kiñ ca cittañ ca te svakāryāt saṃskārābhimukhavṛttibhyo 'vasādayanti viramayanti| khyātiparyavasānaṃ hi cittavicoṣtitam|
analyzed: kim ca cittam ca te sva kāryāt saṃskāra abhimukha vṛttibhyaḥ vasādayanti viramayanti khyāti paryavasānam hi

original: puruṣakhyātiś ca jātā saṃskāraś ca bhavatīti viruddham||
analyzed: puruṣa khyātiḥ ca jātā saṃskāraḥ ca bhavati iti viruddham

original: [117,23] yo hi vigatatṛṣṇāsamuāyo nāsau pānīyaṃ pipāsati| etāvad eva cittena puruṣasya karaṇīyam| na hi kaścit kṛtaṃ karaṇīyaṃ cikīrṣati||1.50||
analyzed: yaḥ hi vigata tṛṣṇā samuāyaḥ na asau pānīyam pipāsati etāvat eva cittena puruṣasya karaṇīyam na hi kaścid kṛtam karaṇīyam cikīrṣati

original: [118,8] kiñ ca tasyāpi nirodhe sarvanirodhān nirbījas samādhir iti| iti śabdaḥ parisamāptyarthaḥ| tasyāpi samādhiprajñāprabhavasya saṃskārasyābhinavasya nirodhe^ apiśabdāt saṃskārakāraṇasya samādhiprajñāyā api nirodhe sarvanirodho bhavati| uktam evopāyadvayaṃ
analyzed: kim ca tasya api nirodhe sarva nirodhāt nirbījaḥ samādhiḥ iti iti śabdaḥ parisamāpti arthaḥ tasya api samādhi prajñā prabhavasya saṃskārasya abhinavasya nirodhe apiśabdāt saṃskāra kāraṇasya samādhi prajñāyāḥ api nirodhe sarva nirodhaḥ bhavati uktam eva upāya dvayam

original: paravairāgyavirāmapratyayābhyāsākhyaṃ tannirodhasya||
analyzed: para vairāgya virāma pratyaya abhyāsa ākhyam tat nirodhasya

original: [118,12] kiṃ punas tat sarvaṃ ṛtambharaprajñā-janitasaṃskāraḥ samādhiprajñānirodhī yathā^ eva tāṃ samādhiprajñām ṛtambharāṃ niruṇāddhi tathaivātmanā sahātmasajātīyānāṃ svakāraṇaprajñkṛtānāṃ saṃskārāṇām api
analyzed: kim punar tat sarvam ṛtambhara prajñā janita saṃskāraḥ samādhi prajñā nirodhī yathā eva tām samādhi prajñām ṛtambharām niruṇāt hi tathā eva ātmanā saha ātma sajātīyānām sva kāraṇa prajñkṛtānām saṃskārāṇām api

original: pratibandhī nirodhād bhavati||
analyzed: pratibandhī nirodhāt bhavati

original: [118,17] kasmāt nirodhajaḥ saṃskāraḥ yasmāt samādhiprajñāyās tajjanmanaś ca saṃskārasya nirodhe nirodhakaḥ samādhiprajñājanitasaṃskārād anyo jāyate sa cāpi yataḥ samādhiprajñāṃ tajjanitasaṃskārāṃścātiraskṛtasya na janma
analyzed: kasmāt nirodha jaḥ saṃskāraḥ yasmāt samādhi prajñāyāḥ tad janmanaḥ ca saṃskārasya nirodhe nirodhakaḥ samādhi prajñā janita saṃskārāt anyaḥ jāyate sa ca api yatas samādhi prajñām tad janita saṃskārān ca a tiraskṛtasya na janma

original: pratipadyate tasmāt sa nirodhajaḥ saṃskāraḥ samādhijān saṃskāran bādhata iti||
analyzed: pratipadyate tasmāt sa nirodha jaḥ saṃskāraḥ samādhi jān saṃskāran bādhate iti

original: [118,21] kathaṃ punar asau nirodhajaḥ saṃskāro 'stīti gamyate vidyamane api sa bādhako bhavatīti^ āha nirodhasthitikālakramānubhaveneti| nirodhasya sthitis tasyāḥ kālaḥ sa ca kālaḥ krameṇānubhūyate yataḥ
analyzed: katham punar asau nirodha jaḥ saṃskāraḥ sti iti gamyate vidyamane api sa bādhakaḥ bhavati iti āha nirodha sthiti kāla krama anubhavena iti nirodhasya sthitiḥ tasyāḥ kālaḥ sa ca kālaḥ krameṇa anubhūyate yatas

original: pratabhyāsam abhivardhate tasmāt tena nirodhasthitikālakremānubhavena nirodhacittakṛtaṃ nirodhāvasthacittakṛtaṃ saṃskārāstitvam anumeyam||
analyzed: abhivardhate tasmāt tena nirodha sthiti kāla krema anubhavena nirodha citta kṛtam nirodha avastha citta kṛtam saṃskāra astitvam anumeyam

original: [119,10] vyutthānanirodhasamādhiprabhavaiḥ vyutthānasamādhiprabhavaiḥ nirodhasamādhiprabhavaś ca saha kaivalyabhāgīyaiḥ saṃskāraiś cittaṃ avasitādhikāratvāt svasyāṃ prakṛtau svakāraṇe 'smitāyām ahaṅkāre pravilīyate pratyastameti| tasmāt te khyātinirodhajnmānaḥ saṃskārā yasmāt cittasyādhikāravirodhinaḥ na sthitihetavo bhavantīti||
analyzed: vyutthāna nirodha samādhi prabhavaiḥ vyutthāna samādhi prabhavaiḥ nirodha samādhi prabhavaḥ ca saha kaivalya bhāgīyaiḥ saṃskāraiḥ cittam avasita adhikāra tvāt svasyām prakṛtau sva kāraṇe smitāyām ahaṅkāre pravilīyate pratyastam eti tasmāt te khyāti nirodha jnmānaḥ saṃskārāḥ yasmāt cittasya adhikāra virodhinaḥ na sthiti hetavaḥ bhavanti iti

original: [119,16] yasmād avasitādhikāraṃ saha kaivalyabhāgīyaiḥ saṃskāraiś cittaṃ yaṃ puruṣaṃ prati caritaprayojanaṃ tasmāt nirvartate| tasminvinivṛtte puruṣaḥ svarūpamātrapratiṣṭhaḥ kevalo mukta^ ity ucyate cittavṛttinivṛttir eva muktiḥ iti ||1.51||
analyzed: yasmāt avasita adhikāram saha kaivalya bhāgīyaiḥ saṃskāraiḥ cittam yam puruṣam prati carita prayojanam tasmāt nirvartate tasmin vinivṛtte puruṣaḥ svarūpa mātra pratiṣṭhaḥ kevalaḥ muktaḥ iti ucyate citta vṛtti nivṛttiḥ eva muktiḥ iti

original: [119,19]iti śrīgovindabhavgavatpūjyapādaśiṣyasya paramahaṃsaparivrājakācāryasya śrī-śaṅkarabhagavataḥ kṛtau śrīpātañjalayoga(śāstra)sūtrabhāṣyavivaraṇe ||prathamaḥ samādhipādaḥ||
analyzed: pūjya pāda śiṣyasya paramahaṃsa parivrājaka ācāryasya śrī śaṅkara bhagavataḥ kṛtau śrī pātañjala yoga śāstra sūtra bhāṣya vivaraṇe prathamaḥ samādhi pādaḥ

original: [121,10] athedānīṃ dvitīyaḥ sādhanapāda ārabhyate| kaivalyasya sādhanaṃ samyagdarśanam| yogasādhanāni ca yogadvāreṇa samyagdarśanasādhanāny eva| tāni ca prādhānyenāsmin pāde pratipādyanta iti sādhanapāda ity ucyate||
analyzed: atha idānīm dvitīyaḥ sādhana pādaḥ ārabhyate kaivalyasya sādhanam samyagdarśanam yoga sādhanāni ca yoga dvāreṇa samyagdarśana sādhanāni eva tāni ca prādhānyena asmin pāde pratipādyante iti sādhana pādaḥ iti ucyate

original: [121,13] tathā yogasādhanānuṣṭhānapravṛttasyānuṣaṅgikavibhūteḥ prādhānyena pratipādanād vibhūtipāda^ ity ucyate tṛtīyaḥ 121,15   tathā sakalayogaiśvaryavibhūtibhyo viraktasya sarvopasaṃhāradvāreṇa kaivalyasya prādhānyena pradarśanāt kaivalyapāda^ ity ucyate caturthaḥ||
analyzed: tathā yoga sādhana anuṣṭhāna pravṛttasya ānuṣaṅgika vibhūteḥ prādhānyena pratipādanāt vibhūti pādaḥ iti ucyate tṛtīyaḥ tathā sakala yoga aiśvarya vibhūtibhyaḥ viraktasya sarva upasaṃhāra dvāreṇa kaivalyasya prādhānyena pradarśanāt kaivalya pādaḥ iti ucyate caturthaḥ

original: [121,15] tathā samādhiḥ prādhānyenādāv upālbhyāta iti prathamaḥ samādhipāda ity ucyate||
analyzed: tathā samādhiḥ prādhānyena ādau iti prathamaḥ samādhi pādaḥ iti ucyate

original: [121,19] tad etad āha^ uddiṣṭaḥ samāhitacittasya yoga^ iti karmaṇy acittasya^ ity arthaḥ| maitrīkaruṇādibhāvanādyupā(khyā)yalabdhisthitipadasya yoginaḥ
analyzed: tat etat āha uddiṣṭaḥ samāhita cittasya yogaḥ iti karmaṇi acittasya iti arthaḥ maitrī karuṇā ādi bhāvanā ādi upākhyāya labdhi sthiti padasya yoginaḥ

original: paravairāgyavirāmapratyayyasādhano nirbījaḥ samādhir uddiṣṭaḥ| kathaṃ vyutthitacitto api yoga-yuktaḥ syād iti| vikṣiptacitto api kathaṃ nāma samādhiyogyo bhaved ity ata^ idam ārabhyate|
analyzed: para vairāgya virāma pratyayya sādhanaḥ nirbījaḥ samādhiḥ uddiṣṭaḥ katham vyutthita cittaḥ api yoga yuktaḥ syāt iti vikṣipta cittaḥ api katham nāma samādhi yogyaḥ bhavet iti atas idam ārabhyate

original: [121,23] tapādisādhanam anukramyate tapas-svādhyāya-īśvarapraṇidhānāni kriyā-yogaḥ| nanu ca tapas-svādhyāya-īśvarapraṇidhānāni niyameṣu vadiṣyamāṇāni kim artham ihocyante||
analyzed: tapa ādi sādhanam anukramyate tapaḥ svādhyāya īśvara praṇidhānāni kriyā yogaḥ nanu ca tapaḥ svādhyāya īśvara praṇidhānāni niyameṣu vadiṣyamāṇāni kim artham iha ucyante

original: [122,1] nanu ca^ etad eva prayojanaṃ yad^ uktaṃ vyutthitacitto api yoga-yuktaḥ syād iti||
analyzed: nanu ca etat eva prayojanam yat uktam vyutthita cittaḥ api yoga yuktaḥ syāt iti

original: [122,2] na^ etad asti yatra niyamāḥ paṭhyante tatra^ evedaṃ prayojanaṃ sidhyati||
analyzed: na etat asti yatra niyamāḥ paṭhyante tatra eva idam prayojanam sidhyati

original: [122,3] atha kleśatanūkaraṇārtham iti cet tasyāpi tatra^ evābhidhānāt| yathā "yogāṅgānuṣṭhānād aśuddhikṣaye" iti| aśuddhiś ca kleśādiḥ| samdhibhāvanārthañ ca yogāṅgānuṣṭhānam āmnāyiṣyata^ eva| yathā śamādhisiddhr īśvarapraṇidhānāt" iti| tasmād iha tapādisamāmnānam anarthakam||
analyzed: atha kleśa tanūkaraṇa artham iti ced tasya api tatra eva abhidhānāt yathā yogāṅga anuṣṭhānāt aśuddhi kṣaye iti aśuddhiḥ ca kleśa ādiḥ samdhi bhāvanā artham ca yogāṅga anuṣṭhānam āmnāyiṣyate eva yathā śama ādhi siddhḥ īśvara praṇidhānāt iti tasmāt iha tapa ādi samāmnānam anarthakam

original: [122,7] na yogāṅgānuṣṭhānasya samyagdarśanopāyasya samyagdarśanapūrvatvapratipādanārthatvāt| sarvāṇi ca yogāṅgāni samyagdarśanopāyatvāt samyagdarśanaprāk kālāni| teṣāṃ ca niyamarkadeśa^ iha paṭhitaḥ sarvopāyaprākk-ālatve nidarśanāya| yady apy upāyatvād eva prāk-kālatvam arthāt siddham tathā api spaṣṭatvam evaṃ sati syād iti||

original: [123,4] nanu parastād evaitad vakṣyati śamādhisiddhir iśvarapraṇidhānāt(_Y_ṣ 2.45)" "kāyendriyasiddhir aśuddhikṣayāt tapasaḥ(_Y_ṣ 2.43)" ity evam| pratyekasādhanānāṃ siddhiṃ ca vakṣyati||
analyzed: nanu parastāt eva etat vakṣyati śama ādhi siddhiḥ iśvara praṇidhānāt 245 kāya indriya siddhiḥ aśuddhi kṣayāt tapasaḥ iti evam pratyeka sādhanānām siddhim ca vakṣyati

original: [123,7] na^ etad asti siddhānām iha tatra sādhanastutyartham anuvādāt| atra hi tādarthyam ucyate| tathā ca^ āha śamādhibhāvanārthaḥ kleśatanūkaraṇārthaś ca(_Y_ṣ 2.2)" iti| tatra hy anūdyante sādhanastutaye||
analyzed: na etat asti siddhānām iha tatra sādhana stuti artham anuvādāt atra hi tādarthyam ucyate tathā ca āha śama ādhi bhāvanā arthaḥ kleśa tanūkaraṇa arthaḥ iti tatra hi anūdyante sādhana stutaye

original: [123,10] samprati sūtrākṣarāṇi vyākhyāyante tapaś ca svādhyāyaś ca^ īśvarapraṇidhānañ ca tapas-svādhyāya-īśvarapraṇidhānāni| tāny eva kriyārūpo yogaḥ kriyāyogah| tapādikriyā ca yogārthatvād yoga^ ity ucyate| cittadharmo hi samādhir yogaḥ| tadarthaś cāyaṃ kriyā-yogaḥ| tasmād anena kriyā-yogena yogīti||
analyzed: samprati sūtra akṣarāṇi vyākhyāyante tapaḥ ca svādhyāyaḥ ca īśvara praṇidhānam ca tapaḥ svādhyāya īśvara praṇidhānāni tāni eva kriyā rūpaḥ yogaḥ tapa ādi kriyā ca yoga artha tvāt yogaḥ iti ucyate citta dharmaḥ hi samādhiḥ yogaḥ tad arthaḥ ca ayam kriyāyogaḥ tasmāt anena kriyāyogena yogī iti

original: [123,14] tapa^ iti kṛcchracāndrāyaṇādi śītoṣṇādidvandvasahatvam| svādhyāyaḥ praṇavasya mokṣaśāstrāṇāṃ copanisatprabhṛtīnāṃ pavitrāṇāṃ japaḥ| īśvarapraṇidhānaṃ kriyāṇāṃ paramagurāv īśvare samarpaṇam| tāsāṃ vā phalasaṃnyāsaḥ parameśvare saṃnyasanam||
analyzed: tapaḥ iti kṛcchra cāndrāyaṇa ādi śīta uṣṇa ādi dvandva saha tvam svādhyāyaḥ praṇavasya mokṣa śāstrāṇām ca upani sat prabhṛtīnām pavitrāṇām japaḥ īśvara praṇidhānam kriyāṇām parama gurau īśvare samarpaṇam tāsām vā phala saṃnyāsaḥ parameśvare saṃnyasanam

original: [123,17] kathaṃ punaś cittasamādhānaṃ prati viprakṛṣṭasya kāyakleśādirūpasya tapaso yogatvam svādhyāya-īśvarapraṇidhānayos tu yuktam antaraṅgatvād yogatvam iti tadartham āha nātapasvino yogaḥ sidhyatīti||
analyzed: katham punar citta samādhānam prati viprakṛṣṭasya kāya kleśa ādi rūpasya tapasaḥ yoga tvam svādhyāya īśvara praṇidhānayoḥ tu yuktam antaraṅga tvāt yoga tvam iti tad artham āha na atapasvinaḥ yogaḥ sidhyati iti

original: [123,20] śarīrādipoṣaṇābhiratacittasya kāyendriyamanaḥkhed aparihārāyaṇasyātyantaśarīrādy ātmatvadarśinaḥ sukumārataraṃmanyasya na yogaḥ sidhyatīti tapasa^ upādānam||

original: [123,22] kiñ cānādivāsanācitrā viṣayagrahaṇavāsanābhir anādikālabhir uparacitavicitrabhāvā tathā pratypasthitaviṣayajālā vartamānakālā viṣayā eva jālaṃ tena ca vartamānaviṣayākhyena jālena^ ānāyena jhaṣan iva cittaṃ acuddhiḥ pāśayati yā sā pratyupasthitaviṣayajalā satī yasmāt (124,13) ṇaṇṭāṛeṇa tapasā vinā sambhedaṃ vināśam āpadyate^
analyzed: kim ca anādi vāsanā citrā viṣaya grahaṇa vāsanābhiḥ anādi kālabhiḥ uparacita vicitra bhāvā tathā pratypasthita viṣaya jālā vartamāna kālāḥ viṣayāḥ eva jālam tena ca vartamāna viṣaya ākhyena jālena ānāyena jhaṣan iva cittam a cuddhiḥ pāśayati yā sā pratyupasthita viṣaya jalā satī yasmāt

original: asambhinnāśuddheś cittasya kutaḥ samādhiḥ iti tatsambhedanāya ca tapasa^ upādānam| tac ca tapah cittaprasādanaṃ samādhyantaraṅgaṃ abādhamānam anenāsevyam iti yogā manyante| cittaprasādārthatvāt tapasas tam eva ced bādheta tādarthyam eva hīyate||2.1||
analyzed: asambhinna aśuddheḥ cittasya kutas samādhiḥ iti tad sambhedanāya ca tapasaḥ upādānam tat ca tapat citta prasādanam samādhi antaraṅgam a bādhamānam anena āsevyam iti yogāḥ manyante citta prasāda artha tvāt tapasaḥ tam eva ced bādheta tādarthyam eva hīyate

original: [124,17] sa hi kriyā-yogaḥ kim artha^ iti tasya pārārthyapratipādanārtham āha samādhibhāvanārthaḥ kleśatanūkaraṇāyaś ca||
analyzed: sa hi kriyāyogaḥ kim arthaḥ iti tasya pārārthya pratipādana artham āha samādhi bhāvanā arthaḥ ca

original: [124,19] kathaṃ punar ubhayārthatvam ity āha sa hi^ āsevyamānaḥ samādhiṃ bhāvayati| itara-yogāṅgasahitaḥ samādhiṃ bhāvayati kleśāś ca tanū-karoti| vakṣyati ca "yogāṅgānuṣṭhānād aśuddhikṣaye jñānadīptir ā vivekakhyāteḥ(_Y_ṣ 2.48)"  iti| tad etad āha tanūkṛtān kleśān
analyzed: katham punar ubhaya artha tvam iti āha sa hi āsevyamānaḥ samādhim bhāvayati itara yogāṅga sahitaḥ samādhim bhāvayati kleśāḥ ca tanūkaroti vakṣyati ca yogāṅga anuṣṭhānāt aśuddhi kṣaye jñāna dīptiḥ viveka khyāteḥ iti tat etat āha tanūkṛtān kleśān

original: [125,7] teṣāṃ tanūkaraṇānujanmā punaḥ kleśair aparāmṛṣṭā satvapuruṣānyatāmātrakhyātiḥ samāptādhikārā prajñā pratiprasavāya [kalpiṣyate] saṃsārābhimukhatāyai punar na kalpiṣyate||

original: [125,10] yady api śāstrācāryopadeśena yogāṅgānuṣṭhānād ṛte api satvapuruṣānyatāmātrakhyātir upajāyate tathā api na kleśādharmādīnatīvātiraskṛtya sā jāyateti punaḥ punaḥ kleśādibhiḥ
analyzed: yadi api śāstra ācārya upadeśena yogāṅga anuṣṭhānāt ṛte api sattva puruṣa anya tā mātra khyātiḥ upajāyate tathā api na kleśa adharma ādīn atīva a tiraskṛtya sā jāyata iti punar punar kleśa ādibhiḥ

original: [125,14] ke te kleśāḥ svarūpeṇa kiyanto vā saṃkhyayā iti saṃkhyāsvarūpapratipādanārthaṃ sūtraṃ praṇīyate avidyā-asmitā-rāgadveśābhiniveśāḥ kleśāḥ eṣām ekaikasya lakṣaṇaṃ sūtrair eva vyākhyāyiṣyata^ iti [na] vyākhyeyatve yatnaḥ kriyate vyākhyeyaṃ tv etāvad eva||
analyzed: ke te kleśāḥ sva rūpeṇa kiyantaḥ vā saṃkhyayā iti saṃkhyā sva rūpa pratipādana artham sūtram praṇīyate avidyā asmitā rāga dveśa abhiniveśāḥ kleśāḥ eṣām ekaikasya lakṣaṇam sūtraiḥ eva vyākhyāyiṣyate iti na vyākhyeya tve yatnaḥ kriyate vyākhyeyam tu etāvat eva

original: [125,18] yathā pramāṇaviparyayavikalpādayaḥ parasparabhinnāḥ na tathā kleśānāṃ viparyayād bhedaḥ| kintarhi viparyayasya^ evaite bhedā iti| kasmāt viparyayabhāvabhāvitvād ity etad āha pañca viparyayā ity arthaḥ||
analyzed: yathā pramāṇa viparyaya vikalpa ādayaḥ paraspara bhinnāḥ na tathā kleśānām viparyayāt bhedaḥ kintarhi viparyayasya eva ete bhedāḥ iti kasmāt viparyaya bhāva bhāvi tvāt iti etat āha pañca viparyayāḥ iti arthaḥ

original: [125,21] nanu ca yathā vṛttibhedavyākhyāne pramāṇavṛtteḥ "pratykṣānumānāgamāḥ pramāṇāni" iti tridhā bhedas tatra^ eva vyākhyātaḥ tathā kasmāt tatra^ evāsya viparyayasyāpi bhedaḥ pañcadhā nopavyākhyātaḥ cittavṛtter eva ca viparyaya^ ity uktam| tathā codāhataṃśadviṣayeṇaikacandradarśanena dvicandradarśanaṃ bādhyate" iti||
analyzed: nanu ca yathā vṛtti bheda vyākhyāne pramāṇa vṛtteḥ pratykṣā anumāna āgamāḥ pramāṇāni iti tridhā bhedaḥ tatra eva vyākhyātaḥ tathā kasmāt tatra eva asya viparyayasya api bhedaḥ pañcadhā na upavyākhyātaḥ citta vṛtteḥ eva ca viparyayaḥ iti uktam tathā ca udāhata ṃśat viṣayeṇa eka candra darśanena dvi candra darśanam bādhyate iti

original: [126,6] na^eṣa doṣaḥ kleśānām avṛttikatvāt| na hi kleśāḥ pratyayamātrāḥ

original: [126,9] yadi hi pratyaya^ eva viparyayyaḥ tadā yathā kleśanirodhe api yoginaḥ smṛtipramāṇapratyayā bhavanti tathā viparyayo api bhavet| na tu viparyayaḥ kṣīṇakleśānām| tasmāc cakṣuṣa^ ivāyathārthagrahaṇanimittaṃ

original: [126,13] tat punaḥ pratyayavyatirekeṇa pratipattum ākhyātuṃ cāśakyam iti pratyayena^ evākhyāyate "viparyayo vṛttiḥ" iti| tathā ca vṛttayaḥ kliṣṭākliṣṭaś ceti kleśena viśeṣitāḥ| na ca vṛttibhr eva vṛttīnāṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ yuktam| tathā "kleśahetukā" iti ca vyākhgyātam| na ca vṛttaya eva vṛttihetukā iti yuktam||
analyzed: tat punar pratyaya vyatirekeṇa pratipattum ākhyātum ca aśakyam iti pratyayena eva ākhyāyate viparyayaḥ vṛttiḥ iti tathā ca vṛttayaḥ kliṣṭa akliṣṭaḥ ca iti kleśena viśeṣitāḥ na ca vṛttibhiḥ eva vṛttīnām viśeṣaṇam yuktam tathā kleśa hetukāḥ iti ca vyākhyātam na ca vṛttayaḥ eva vṛtti hetukāḥ iti yuktam

original: [183,14] na---āgamavirodhāt| tasmād vā etasmādātmana ākāśaḥ sambhūtaḥityāgamavirodhaḥ| smṛtivirodhaś ca| avakāśaṃ kurvati tadupacāra iticenna, vāyvādiṣv apyupacāraprasaṅgāt| ākāśād vāyuḥ sambhūtaityekavākyatvāt ||

original: [183,17] prāgutpatter viśeṣābhāvād anityo na bhavatīti ca bruvatā viśeṣābhāvānnityatvam ityuktaṃ bhavati| tathā ca saty ātmādīnām apibandhamokṣopalabdhyādiviśeṣābhāvāt sato vaiśeṣikasya anityatvaprasaṅgaḥ/ tathā paramāṇvādīnāṃ cānityatvaṃ prasajyeta ||

original: [183,21] athāpyutpattimata eva prāgūrdhvaṃ ca viśeṣabhāvābhāvau vivakṣitāviticet---na---ākāśasyotpattyabhyupagamaprasaṅgāt| athākāśotpattivādināviśeṣo vaktuṃ na śakyata iticet---na---puruṣārthasādhanāsādhanatvaviśeṣāt| sarvagatatvāditicāsiddho hetuḥ ||

original: parārthatvātghaṭādivat| utpattimanti ca pradhānupuruṣābhyām anyatvāt ghaṭādivat| evam ākāśaṃ [utpattimad anityaṃ ca] bāhyendriyaviṣayatvāt ghaṭādivat| bhūtatvāc ca pṛthivīvat| anityadravyasaṃyogotādyaguṇatvāt|

original: [184,7] etāni ca bhūtāni śabdasparśarūparasagandhatanmātrāṇām aviśeṣāṇāṃ viśeṣāḥ| śāntaghoramūḍhādy anekaviśeṣavattvād viśeṣāḥ| śāntādyavhāvāc cāviśeṣāḥ tan-mātrāṇi||
analyzed: etāni ca bhūtāni śabda sparśa rūpa rasa gandha tanmātrāṇām aviśeṣāṇām viśeṣāḥ śānta ghora mūḍha ādi aneka viśeṣa vat tvāt viśeṣāḥ śānta ādi avhāvāt ca aviśeṣāḥ tanmātrāṇi

original: [184,10] tathā śrotratvakcakṣur jihvāghrāṇāni śabdādiviṣayabuddhyarthatvād buddhīndiryāṇi svaviṣayabuddhibhir evānumitāni| vākpāṇipādapāyūpasthāni karmendriyāṇi vacanādikriyānirvartakāni tadanimitāny eva| na vādādīni karmendriyāṇi siddhānīti cen na śrutiprasiddhatvāt| indriyāṇi prakṛtya sarveṣāṃ vedānāṃ vāgekāyanam ityādiśruteḥ||
analyzed: tathā śrotra tvac cakṣuḥ jihvā ghrāṇāni śabda ādi viṣaya buddhi artha tvāt buddhīndiryāṇi sva viṣaya buddhibhiḥ eva anumitāni vāc pāṇi pāda pāyu upasthāni karmendriyāṇi vacana ādi kriyā nirvartakāni tad animitāni eva na vāda ādīni karmendriyāṇi siddhāni iti ced na śruti prasiddha tvāt indriyāṇi prakṛtya sarveṣām vedānām vāc ekāyanam ityādi śruteḥ

original: [184,16] smṛtiṣu ca sarvatraiva vidhipratiṣedhaviṣayapravṛttinivṛttimatvāc ca śrotrādivad indryatvam| na vākyacapalo na pāṇipādacapalaḥ ityāder vidhipratiṣedhaviṣayapravṛttinivṛttimattvasiddhiḥ||
analyzed: smṛtiṣu ca sarvatra eva vidhi pratiṣedha viṣaya pravṛtti nivṛttima tvāt ca śrotra ādi vat indri atvam na vākya capalaḥ na pāṇi pāda capalaḥ ityādeḥ vidhi pratiṣedha viṣaya pravṛtti nivṛttimat tva siddhiḥ

original: [184,19] tathā vāgāḍīnīndriyāṇi kauśalavattvāt cakṣurādivat| sarvagātreṣu cendriyaśaktiḥ karaṇavṛttyāḥ sandarśanād iṣyata^ eva| vāggudaprabhṛtīnāṃ sarpādīnāṃ mūkaṣaṇḍānāṃ ca mukham evopasthendriyam| ekādaśaṃ manaḥ sarvārtham atītānāgatavartamānaviṣayārthaṃ buddhīndriyakarmendriyaviṣayārthaṃ ca||
analyzed: tathā vāc āḍīni indriyāṇi kauśalavat tvāt cakṣuḥ ādi vat sarva gātreṣu ca indriya śaktiḥ karaṇa vṛttyāḥ sandarśanāt iṣyate eva vāc guda prabhṛtīnām sarpa ādīnām mūka ṣaṇḍānām ca mukham eva upastha indriyam ekādaśam manaḥ sarva artham atīta anāgata vartamāna viṣaya artham buddhīndriya karmendriya viṣaya artham ca

original: [184,23] etāny ekādaśendriyāṇy asmitā-lakṣaṇasyāsmibhāvo 'smitā^ asmīti pratyayaḥ sa ca lakṣaṇaṃ yasya so 'smitalakṣaṇo 'smitāpratyayena hi lakṣyate liṅgyate ṣaṣṭham aviśeṣākhyaṃ tattvam ahaṅkāraḥ| tasyāviśeṣasya viśeṣā etāni(184,26) guṇānām aviśeṣākārasaṃsthitānāṃ sattvādīnām eṣa ṣodaśako viśeṣapariṇāmaḥ sattvabahulā pṛthivī grāhyatvāt|
analyzed: etāni ekādaśa indriyāṇi smitā lakṣaṇasya smitā asmi iti pratyayaḥ sa ca lakṣaṇam yasya saḥ smita lakṣaṇaḥ smitā pratyayena hi lakṣyate liṅgyate ṣaṣṭham aviśeṣa ākhyam tattvam ahaṅkāraḥ tasya aviśeṣasya viśeṣāḥ etāni guṇānām aviśeṣa ākāra saṃsthitānām sattva ādīnām eṣa ṣodaśakaḥ viśeṣa pariṇāmaḥ sattva bahulā pṛthivī grāhya tvāt

original: tām asattve apy eṣāṃ guṇapradhānakṛto viśeṣaḥ| (185,12) karaṇāni prakāśatvāt sattvabahulāni manaḥṣaṣṭhāni tu buddhīndriyāṇi prakāśaprādhānyāt sattvabahulāni| karnebdruyāṇi kriyāprādhānyād rajo-bahulāni ||
analyzed: tām a sattve api eṣām guṇa pradhāna kṛtaḥ viśeṣaḥ karaṇāni prakāśa tvāt sattva bahulāni manaḥ ṣaṣṭhāni tu buddhīndriyāṇi prakāśa prādhānyāt sattva bahulāni kriyā prādhānyāt rajaḥ bahulāni

original: [185,14] ṣaḍ-aviśeṣāḥ| tadyathā śabdamātraṃ sparśamātram iti dvilakṣaṇasyāpi pradhānena vyapadeśaḥ| tathā rūpamātram iti trilakṣaṇasyāpi pradhānena vyapadeśaḥ| tathottarayor api mātraśabdaḥ śāntaghorādiviśeṣavyāvartanārthaḥ| ekadvitricatuḥpañcalakṣaṇabhedāḥ śabdatattvaikalakṣaṇaḥ śabdatanmātrabhedaḥ|
analyzed: ṣaṣ aviśeṣāḥ tat yathā śabda mātram sparśa mātram iti dvi lakṣaṇasya api pradhānena vyapadeśaḥ tathā rūpa mātram iti tri lakṣaṇasya api pradhānena vyapadeśaḥ tathā uttarayoḥ api mātra śabdaḥ śānta ghora ādi viśeṣa vyāvartana arthaḥ eka dvi tri catur pañca lakṣaṇa bhedāḥ śabda tattva eka lakṣaṇaḥ śabda tanmātra bhedaḥ

original: śabdasparśalakṣaṇaḥ sparśatanmātrabhedaḥ ity evam ekaikādhikyenottaratrāpi draṣṭavyam| ṣaṣṭhaś cāviśeṣo 'smitamātraḥ śabdāditanmātrāpekṣayā ṣaṣṭha indriyāṇām ekādaśānām aviśeṣaḥ||
analyzed: śabda sparśa lakṣaṇaḥ sparśa tanmātra bhedaḥ iti evam ekaika ādhikyena uttaratra api draṣṭavyam ṣaṣṭhaḥ ca aviśeṣaḥ smita mātraḥ śabda ādi tanmātra apekṣayā ṣaṣṭhaḥ indriyāṇām ekādaśānām aviśeṣaḥ

original: [185,20] ete sattvamātrasyāstitvamātrasya liṅgamātrasya mūrtimātrasya
analyzed: ete sattva mātrasya astitva mātrasya liṅga mātrasya mūrti mātrasya

original: pradhānasyāmūrtasya prathamā mūrtir iyaṃ yathā bījasyāṅkurībhāvaḥ| ātmano vasturūpasya mahataḥ sarvaviśeṣāviśeṣebhyo mahattvāt ṣaḍ-aviśeṣapariṇāmāḥ ṣaḍ-aviśeṣā eva pariṇāmāḥ sattvādīnāṃ mahadrūpāvasthitānām amī aviśeṣapariṇāmāḥ ||
analyzed: pradhānasya amūrtasya prathamā mūrtiḥ iyam yathā bījasya aṅkurībhāvaḥ ātmanaḥ vastu rūpasya mahataḥ sarva viśeṣa aviśeṣebhyaḥ mahat tvāt ṣaṣ aviśeṣa pariṇāmāḥ ṣaṣ aviśeṣāḥ eva pariṇāmāḥ sattva ādīnām mahat rūpa avasthitānām amī aviśeṣa pariṇāmāḥ

original: [185,24] yat tat paraṃ sūkṣmam aviśeṣebhyo liṅgamātraṃ mahattattvam tasminn ete sattāmātre mahattvānmahaty avasthāya kāraṇasvarūpe mahaty avasthāya vivṛddhikāṣṭhāṃ pṛthivyādiviśeṣāntatām anubhavanti||
analyzed: yat tat param sūkṣmam aviśeṣebhyaḥ liṅgamātram mahat tattvam tasmin ete sattā mātre mahā tvāt mahati avasthāya kāraṇa svarūpe mahati avasthāya vivṛddhi kāṣṭhām pṛthivī ādi viśeṣa anta tām anubhavanti

original: [186,14] pratisaṃsṛjyamānāś ca pratilīyamānāś cāviśeṣāḥ tasminn eva sattāmātre liṅgamātre mahaty ātmany avasthāyāvyaktaṃ prati yānti| kiṃ-viśiṣṭam nissattāsattvaṃ viśeṣāviśeṣadharmarahitam| nissad asad iti avyaktādīṣadvikṛtam iti sat aviśeṣebhyaḥ sūkṣmataram iti cāsat sac cāsac ca sad asad iti mahattattvam ucyate|
analyzed: pratisaṃsṛjyamānāḥ ca pratilīyamānāḥ ca aviśeṣāḥ tasmin eva sattā mātre liṅgamātre mahati ātmani avasthāya avyaktam prati yānti kiṃviśiṣṭam nissattā sattvam viśeṣa aviśeṣa dharma rahitam nissat asat iti avyaktāt īṣat vikṛtam iti sat aviśeṣebhyaḥ sūkṣmataram iti ca asat sat ca asat ca sat asat iti mahat tattvam ucyate

analyzed: katham vimarda vaicitryam iti āha yathā saṃsthānam śarīra ādikam ādimat kāraṇavat dharma mātram kāraṇasya ātma bhūtam avyatiriktam vināśi tirobhāva dharmakam dharma antara samudaye keṣām saṃsthānam iti śabda ādīnām avināśinām evam liṅgam mahat ākhyam ādimat kāraṇavat dharma mātram vināśi guṇānām avināśinām ātma bhūtam

original: [256,22] ke punaḥ śāntā uditā^ avyapadeśyā vā te khalu dharmiṇo dharmāḥ śāntāḥ ye kṛtvā vyāpāram paratāḥ| savyāpārā uditāḥṭe cānāgatalakṣaṇasya samanantarāḥ| tathā vartamānasyānantarā^ atītāḥ| kimartham atītasyānantarā na bhavanti | sa santīty arthaḥ pūrvapaścibhābhāvāt| yo yasya paścād bhavati sa tasya (257,10) paścimo 'nantaraḥ|
analyzed: ke punar śāntāḥ uditāḥ a vyapadeśyāḥ vā te khalu dharmiṇaḥ dharmāḥ śāntāḥ ye kṛtvā vyāpāram paratāḥ sa vyāpārāḥ uditāḥ ṭe ca anāgata lakṣaṇasya samanantarāḥ tathā vartamānasya anantarāḥ atītāḥ kimartham atītasya anantarāḥ na bhavanti sa santi iti arthaḥ pūrva paści bhā bhāvāt yaḥ yasya paścāt bhavati sa tasya paścimaḥ nantaraḥ

original: itaraś ca tadapekṣayā pūrvaḥ| tad iha paścibhābhāvāt eṣa svayam api pūrvo na bhavatīti pūrvapaścibhābhāvād atītasyānantarā na santi| yathā^ anāgatavartamānayoḥ pūrvapaścimatā na^ evam atītasya| tasmāt na[nātī]tasyāsti samanantaraḥ||

original: kathaṃ yadā vyutthānasaṃskāro nirodhasaṃskāreṇa^ ādyo 'abhibhūyate tadā vartamānam adhvanaṃ hitvā vyutthānasaṃskāro 'tītam adhvānam upasampadya punar anāgataḥ san vartamānībhavatīty asamanantaro apy anāgata^ eva samanantarībhavaty atītasya^ ity ucyate| atītānāgatayor lakṣaṇayor dharmāṇāṃ dharmisvarūpamātrāviśeṣāt||

original: [257,19] athāvyapadeśyāḥ ke tadavyapadeśyābhipradarśanārtham āha sarvaṃ sarvātmakaṃ iti| katham tatra^ uktam jalabhūmyoḥ pāriṇāmikaṃ rasādivaiśvarūpyaṃ sthāvareṣu dṛṣṭam| yathā rasa^ eka^ eva ikṣuśṛṅkagerakādiṣu madhurakaṭukatvādi vaiśvarūpyaṃ pratipadyate| tathā rūpasya śuklakṛṣṇatvādivicitrarūpatvam| evaṃ gandhādiṣv api|

original: [260,10] idānīṃ pariṇāmabhede hetur ucyate siddhe hi bhede

original: [259,15] trayo hi kramā^ anyonyavidharmāṇa^ upalakṣyante lakṣaṇāvasthākramābhyām anyo dharmakramaḥ| dharmāvasthākramābhyām anyo lakṣaṇakramaḥ| dharmalakṣaṇakramābhyām anyo'vasthākramaḥ| yac ca teṣām anyatvaṃ prasiddhamārgam adhirūḍhaṃ tat kramakāryāṇāṃ pariṇāmānām anumāpakaṃ anyatve hetuḥ||
analyzed: trayaḥ hi kramāḥ anyonya vidharmāṇaḥ upalakṣyante lakṣaṇa avasthā kramābhyām anyaḥ dharma kramaḥ dharma avasthā kramābhyām anyaḥ lakṣaṇa kramaḥ dharma lakṣaṇa kramābhyām anyaḥ vasthā kramaḥ yat ca teṣām anya tvam prasiddha mārgam adhirūḍham tat krama kāryāṇām pariṇāmānām anumāpakam anyatve hetuḥ

original: [260,10] dharmapariṇāmaś ca dvividhaḥ tulyapariṇāmaś cātulyapariṇāmaś ca| yathā piṇḍo ghaṭa upajāyata^ ity atulyapiṇḍasya ghaṭādhidharmair mṛdākhyo dharmī pariṇamate saḥ atulyadharmapariṇāmaḥ| yāvac ca ghaṭasya janmanaḥ prabhṛti^ ā kapālāpatteḥ tāvat ghaṭarūpeṇa^ eva
analyzed: dharma pariṇāmaḥ ca dvividhaḥ tulya pariṇāmaḥ ca atulya pariṇāmaḥ ca yathā piṇḍaḥ ghaṭaḥ upajāyate iti atulya piṇḍasya ghaṭa ādhi dharmaiḥ mṛd ākhyaḥ dharmī pariṇamate saḥ atulya dharma pariṇāmaḥ yāvat ca ghaṭasya janmanaḥ prabhṛti ā kapāla āpatteḥ tāvat ghaṭa rūpeṇa eva

original: [260,14] idānīṃ lakṣaṇapariṇāmakrama^ ucyate lakṣaṇapariṇāmakramaḥ ghaṭasyānāgatāt lakṣaṇāt vartamānabhāvaḥ| tathā piṇḍasya virodhidharmodaye vartamānād atīta[bhāva]ḥ kramaḥ| nātītasyāsti kramaḥ| dharme hi vartamānalakṣaṇasya samanantaraṃ yal-lakṣaṇaṃ sa lakṣaṇakramaḥ| na cātītalakṣaṇasya samanantaraṃ lakṣaṇam asti||

original: [260,18] kasmāt pūrvāparatāyāṃ hi satyāṃ samanantaratvam| sā cātītasya nāsti| tasmāt dvayor evānāgatavartamānayoḥ lakṣaṇayoḥ kramaḥ| atītasya kramābhāvapratipādane prayojanam kṣaṇatatkramayoḥ saṃyamāt ity atra bhaviṣyati ||

original: [260,21] tathā^ avasthāpariṇāmakramaḥ ghaṭasyābhinavasya prānte avasānāvasthāyāṃ purāṇātā dṛśyate| sā ca kṣaṇaparamparā 'nupātinā krameṇābhyūhyamānā (261,10)pratikṣaṇam abhinavabhāvaparimardanena
analyzed: tathā avasthā pariṇāma kramaḥ ghaṭasya abhinavasya prānte avasāna avasthāyām purāṇātā dṛśyate sā ca kṣaṇa paramparā nupātinā krameṇa abhyūhyamānā pratikṣaṇam abhinava bhāva parimardanena

original: purāṇatā sañjaniṣyate| sā ca prānteṣu parāṃ vyaktim āpāditā| madhye tu sūkṣmatayā na vibhāvyate| tena madhyāvasthāyāṃ sann api kramo na lakṣyate| prāntakālābhivyaktiliṅgenānumāyiṣyate yena^ iyaṃ purāṇatā parāṃ vyaktim upaprāpitā so'yaṃ krama^ iti| na hi ghaṭe pariniṣpannmātre
analyzed: purāṇa tā sañjaniṣyate sā ca prānteṣu parām vyaktim āpāditā madhye tu sūkṣma tayā na vibhāvyate tena madhya avasthāyām san api kramaḥ na lakṣyate prānta kāla abhivyakti liṅgena anumāyiṣyate yena iyam purāṇa tā parām vyaktim upaprāpitā saḥ yam kramaḥ iti na hi ghaṭe pariniṣpann mātre

original: [261,15] tathā ca vadiṣyati kṣaṇapratiyāgī pariṇāmāparāntanirgrāhyaḥ kramaḥ iti| tasmāt dharmalakṣaṇakramābhyām avasthākramasyānyatvāt dharmalakṣaṇapariṇāmābhyāṃ viśiṣṭo 'yaṃ tṛtīyaḥ pariṇāmaḥ||
analyzed: tathā ca vadiṣyati kṣaṇa pratiyāgī kramaḥ iti tasmāt dharma lakṣaṇa kramābhyām avasthā kramasya anya tvāt dharma lakṣaṇa pariṇāmābhyām viśiṣṭaḥ yam tṛtīyaḥ pariṇāmaḥ

original: [261,18] ta ete kramā dharmadharmibhede sati pratilabdhasvarūpāḥ|  vivakṣite tu dharmadharmiṇor abhede tatra kramabhedo na labhyate| dharmo api dharmī bhavaty anyadharmāpekṣayā| guṇabhyo 'nyatra dharmadharmitvaṃ nāma na vyavasthitam| mahadādīnām apy aviśeṣāpekṣayā dharmitvam|  aviśeṣāṇāṃ ca viśeṣāpekṣayā viśeṣāṇāṃ ca śāntoditāpekṣayeti|
analyzed: te ete kramāḥ dharma dharmi bhede sati pratilabdha svarūpāḥ vivakṣite tu dharma dharmiṇoḥ abhede tatra krama bhedaḥ na labhyate dharmaḥ api dharmī bhavati anya dharma apekṣayā guṇabhyaḥ nyatra dharma dharmi tvam nāma na vyavasthitam mahat ādīnām api aviśeṣa apekṣayā dharmi tvam aviśeṣāṇām ca viśeṣa apekṣayā viśeṣāṇām ca śānta udita apekṣayā iti

original: yadā tu paramārthato dharmiṇy abhedopacāradvāreṇābhidhīyate dharmaḥ tadā 'yam ekatvena^ eva kramaḥ pratyavabhāsate||
analyzed: yadā tu paramārthataḥ dharmiṇī abheda upacāra dvāreṇa abhidhīyate dharmaḥ tadā yam eka tvena eva kramaḥ pratyavabhāsate

original: [261,24] tatra cittasya dvaye dvīdhāḥ dharmāḥ paridṛṣṭāś cāpariḍṛṣṭāś ca upalabdhāś cānupalabdhāś ca| ke te^ ity āha tatra pratyayātmakāḥ rāgadveṣamohādayaḥ paridṛṣṭāḥ| vastumātrāḥ svarūpeṇa vidyamānāḥ kāryayoginaḥ aparidṛṣṭāḥ| (262,10) [te ca] svaviṣayavṛttisadbhāvaiḥ saptā^ eva bhavanti|
analyzed: tatra cittasya dvaye dvīdhāḥ dharmāḥ paridṛṣṭāḥ ca apariḍṛṣṭāḥ ca upalabdhāḥ ca anupalabdhāḥ ca ke te iti āha tatra pratyaya ātmakāḥ rāga dveṣa moha ādayaḥ paridṛṣṭāḥ vastu mātrāḥ sva rūpeṇa vidyamānāḥ kārya yoginaḥ aparidṛṣṭāḥ te ca sva viṣaya vṛtti sadbhāvaiḥ sapta eva bhavanti

original: te katham avagamyanta^ ity anumānena prāpitavastumātrasadbhāvāḥ kāryāliṅgenāvagatasadbhāvāh| svarūpeṇa tu nānīśvarair upalabhyante| tataś ca^ ekaikatvenocyante||
analyzed: te katham avagamyante iti anumānena prāpita vastu mātra sadbhāvāḥ sva rūpeṇa tu na anīśvaraiḥ upalabhyante tatas ca eka eka tvena ucyante

original: [262,13] nirodhadharmasaṃskārāḥ| nirodhaḥ uktaḥ dharmaḥ iti dharmādharmau|  saṃskārāḥ vāsanārūpāḥ| pariṇāma uktalakṣaṇaḥ| atha jīvanam iti dharmādyapekṣayā sakalakaraṇavṛttiḥ prāṇalakṣaṇā yena cittadharmeṇa bhavati sa jīvanam ity ucyate/ seṣṭā vyāpāraḥ śaktiḥ sāmarthyaṃ cittasya dharmāḥ| darśanavarjitāḥ apratyakṣāḥ|
analyzed: nirodha dharma saṃskārāḥ nirodhaḥ uktaḥ dharmaḥ iti dharma adharmau saṃskārāḥ vāsanā rūpāḥ pariṇāmaḥ ukta lakṣaṇaḥ atha jīvanam iti dharma ādi apekṣayā sakala karaṇa vṛttiḥ prāṇa lakṣaṇā yena citta dharmeṇa bhavati sa jīvanam iti ucyate sa iṣṭā vyāpāraḥ śaktiḥ sāmarthyam cittasya dharmāḥ darśana varjitāḥ apratyakṣāḥ

original: iti^ ete sapta nirodhādayaś cittadharmā^ aparidṛṣṭā ucyante||3.15||

original: [262,18] ete trayaḥ pariṇāmā dharmalakṣaṇāvasthārūpāḥ yoginaḥ upāttasarvasādhanasya samāsasamādita-yamādisakalasādhanasya sthiratarasaṃyamasya atītānāgatapratupasthitabubhutsitārthapratipattaye saṃyamasya viṣayaḥ upakṣipyate| trayoapy eko viṣayaḥ saṃyamasya||
analyzed: ete trayaḥ pariṇāmāḥ dharma lakṣaṇa avasthā rūpāḥ yoginaḥ upātta sarva sādhanasya samāsa samādita yama ādi sakala sādhanasya sthiratara saṃyamasya atīta anāgata pratupa sthita bubhutsita artha pratipattaye saṃyamasya viṣayaḥ upakṣipyate ekaḥ viṣayaḥ saṃyamasya

original: [262,22] pariṇāmatrayasaṃyamād atītānāgatajñānam| pariṇāmatraye tāvat saṃyamaḥ karaṇīyaḥ yāvat samādhiprajñā 'lokaḥ| sa ca yadviṣaya^ upasthitaḥ taṃ viṣayaṃ yathābhūtam pratyakṣatām āpādayati| sūkṣmṃ vyavahitam atītam anāgataṃ viprakṛṣṭaṃ vā yam uddiśya prāpaṇābhiprāyeṇa sūkṣmādiṣu saṃyamaḥ kriyate tadā so 'rtho (263,11)vaśyatāṃ yogina^ upayāti|
analyzed: pariṇāma traya saṃyamāt atīta anāgata jñānam pariṇāma traye tāvat saṃyamaḥ karaṇīyaḥ yāvat samādhi prajñā lokaḥ sa ca yad viṣaye upasthitaḥ tam viṣayam yathābhūtam pratyakṣa tām āpādayati sūkṣmam vyavahitam atītam anāgatam viprakṛṣṭam vā yam uddiśya prāpaṇa abhiprāyeṇa sūkṣma ādiṣu saṃyamaḥ kriyate tadā saḥ rthaḥ vaśyatām yoginaḥ upayāti

original: dharmakṣaṇāvasthāpariṇāmeṣu saṃyamāt yogino bhavaty atītānāgatajñānam|  dhāraṇādhyānasamādhitrayam ekatra saṃyama^ uktaḥ| tena saṃyamena pariṇāmatrayaṃ sākṣātikriyamāṇam atītānāgatajñānam teṣu pariṇāmeṣu sampādayati|
analyzed: dharma kṣaṇa avasthā pariṇāmeṣu saṃyamāt yoginaḥ bhavati atīta anāgata jñānam dhāraṇā dhyāna samādhi trayam ekatra saṃyamaḥ uktaḥ tena saṃyamena pariṇāma trayam sākṣāt kriyamāṇam atīta anāgata jñānam teṣu pariṇāmeṣu sampādayati

original: sakalapadārthānāṃ pariṇāmitvāt teṣāṃ cātītādiyogāt kālatraya-yuktasamastapadārthaviṣayapariṇāmatrayasaṃyamena sarvaṃ pratyakṣībhavati| tathā pratikṣaṇapariṇāmadharmakam anavasthitaṃ viśvam īkṣamāṇasya vairāgyaṃ jāyati||3.16||
analyzed: sakala padārthānām pariṇāmi tvāt teṣām ca atīta ādi yogāt kāla traya yukta samasta padārtha viṣaya pariṇāma traya saṃyamena sarvam pratyakṣībhavati tathā pratikṣaṇa pariṇāma dharmakam anavasthitam viśvam īkṣamāṇasya vairāgyam jāyati

original: [263,17] ayam anyaḥ saṃyamaviṣayaḥ upakṣipyate sarvaśabdārthapratipattyarthaḥ śabdārthapratyayānām itaretarādhyāsāt saṃkaraḥ tat-pravibhāgasaṃyamāt sarvabhūtarutajñānaṃ sampadyate| tatra kaḥ śabdaḥ ko vā arthaḥ pratyayo vā saṃkaraś ca kinnīmittaḥ kathaṃ ca teṣāṃ pravibhāgaḥ iti||
analyzed: ayam anyaḥ saṃyama viṣayaḥ upakṣipyate sarva śabda artha pratipatti arthaḥ śabda artha pratyayānām itaretara adhyāsāt saṃkaraḥ tad pravibhāga saṃyamāt sarva bhūta ruta jñānam sampadyate tatra kaḥ śabdaḥ kaḥ vā arthaḥ pratyayaḥ vā saṃkaraḥ ca kiṃnīmittaḥ katham ca teṣām pravibhāgaḥ iti

original: [263,21] tatra kiṃ vāguccāryaḥ śrotragrāhyaḥ sa śabdaḥ utārthāmtaram kiṃ vāg eva tadvyatirikto vā iti tācad vicāryate vāk tāvan na śabdaḥ| kasmāt vāg varṇeṣv evārthavatī| vā iti varṇābhivyañjakam aṣṭasu sthāneṣu viṣaktam indriyaṃ varṇābhivyaktimātraprayojanopakṣayaṃ na tāvad arrhābhibyaktau śabdābhivyaktau vā vyāpāraṃ karoti||
analyzed: tatra kim vāc uccāryaḥ śrotra grāhyaḥ sa śabdaḥ uta arthāntaram kim vāc eva tad vyatiriktaḥ vā iti tācat vicāryate vāc tāvat na śabdaḥ kasmāt vāc varṇeṣu eva arthavatī vā iti varṇa abhivyañjakam aṣṭasu sthāneṣu viṣaktam indriyam varṇa abhivyakti mātra prayojana upakṣayam na tāvat arrha abhibyaktau śabda abhivyaktau vā vyāpāram karoti

original: [263,26] tathā śrotraṃ ca na svayaṃ śabdaḥ nāpi śabdaviṣayam| kasmāt dhvanipariṇāmamātraviṣayaṃ hi tat| dhvanir iti sāmānyaṃ varṇāvarṇarūpam|  tasya viśeṣaḥ pariṇāmaḥ akārādivarṇātmakaḥ kākādivāśitātmakaś ca mūḍhakaraṇavyaṅgyaḥ| tat dhvanipariṇāmamātraprakāśāvasānaṃ śrotraṃ nārthaśabdayor vyāpriyate||
analyzed: tathā śrotram ca na svayam śabdaḥ na api śabda viṣayam kasmāt dhvani pariṇāma mātra viṣayam hi tat dhvaniḥ iti sāmānyam varṇa avarṇa rūpam tasya viśeṣaḥ pariṇāmaḥ akāra ādi varṇa ātmakaḥ kāka ādi vāśitā ātmakaḥ ca mūḍha karaṇa vyaṅgyaḥ tat dhvani pariṇāma mātra prakāśa avasānam śrotram na artha śabdayoḥ vyāpriyate

original: [264,6] nanu ca śrotragrāhya eva śabdaḥ| na, arthapratyāyakatvāt| arthaṃ yaḥ sampratyāyayati sa śabdaḥ| kaḥ punar asau padam|
analyzed: nanu ca śrotra grāhyaḥ eva śabdaḥ na artha pratyāyaka tvāt artham yaḥ sampratyāyayati sa śabdaḥ kaḥ punar asau padam

original: tat punar nādānusaṃhārabuddhinirgrāhyaṃ nādānāṃ dhbanīnāṃ śrotraviṣayabhūtānāṃ pratyekaṃ pratyayini saṃskāram ādhāya nirvartamānānām antyena dhvaninā yā samupasthāpitā buddhiḥ sā nādānusaṃhārabuddhiḥ prathamadhvanikramānusaṃhārāsāditasaṃskārasya pratyayinaś cittasya jāyate tayaikayā buddhyāyaṃ nirgṛhyate|
analyzed: tat punar nāda anusaṃhāra buddhi nirgrāhyam nādānām dhbanīnām śrotra viṣaya bhūtānām pratyekam pratyayini saṃskāram ādhāya nirvartamānānām antyena dhvaninā yā samupasthāpitā buddhiḥ sā nāda anusaṃhāra buddhiḥ prathama dhvani krama anusaṃhāra āsādita saṃskārasya pratyayinaḥ cittasya jāyate tayā ekayā buddhyā ayam nirgṛhyate

original: tat padam tac ca pratyakṣatvāt rūpādivan nānyapramāṇāpekṣam||
analyzed: tat padam tat ca pratyakṣa tvāt rūpa ādi vat na anya pramāṇa apekṣam

original: [264,13] nanu ca gakāraukāravisarjanīyāḥ iti bhagavān upavarṣaḥ| tan na avācakatvāt| katham samudāyāsambhavāt| samudāyāsambhavaś ca ekasamayāsambhavitvāt| na hi gakāroccāraṇakāle^ aukāravisarjanīyau| nāpy aukāroccāraṇakāle gakāravisarjanīyau| nāpi visarjanīyapravṛttivelāyām itarayoḥ samavasthānam iti varṇasamudāyāsambhvād avācakatvam||
analyzed: nanu ca gakāra aukāra visarjanīyāḥ iti bhagavān upavarṣaḥ tat na avācaka tvāt katham samudāya asambhavāt samudāya asambhavaḥ ca eka samaya asambhavi tvāt na hi gakāra uccāraṇa kāle aukāra visarjanīyau na api aukāra uccāraṇa kāle gakāra visarjanīyau na api visarjanīya pravṛtti velāyām itarayoḥ samavasthānam iti varṇa samudāya asambhvāt avācaka tvam

original: [264,18] yathā^ eva varṇānāṃ yugapatsamayānavasthānam  evaṃ saṃskārāṇām smṛtīnāṃ ca tajjanitānām ayugapatkālatvād avācakatvam|  smṛtyupayogārthatvāc ca saṃskārasyānubhūtaviṣaya^ eva^ upayogāt pratyāyasya cāpūrvatvāt||
analyzed: yathā eva varṇānām yugapad samaya anavasthānam evam saṃskārāṇām smṛtīnām ca tad janitānām ayugapad kāla tvāt avācaka tvam smṛti upayoga artha tvāt ca saṃskārasya anubhūta viṣaye eva upayogāt pratyāyasya ca apūrva tvāt

original: [264,21] api ca saṃskārāṇāṃ vācakatvābhyupagame śabdād arthapratipattiḥ pūrvāparībhūtaṃ bhāvam ākhyātenācaṣṭe dharmasya śabdamūlatvād aśabdama anapekṣyaṃ syāt iti prasiddhir apahnūyate||
analyzed: api ca saṃskārāṇām vācaka tva abhyupagame śabdāt artha pratipattiḥ pūrvāparībhūtam bhāvam ākhyātena ācaṣṭe dharmasya śabda mūla tvāt an apekṣyam syāt iti prasiddhiḥ apahnūyate

original: [264,24] athāpi varṇabhāvabhāvitvena smṛtisaṃskārayor api śabdatvam upacaryeta| na^ etad api tadbhāvabhāvitvaṃ nāma tasminn eva sati bhavaty asty abhāva^ eva yatra tatra syāt| (na ca) tac ca varṇānāṃ śabdatve siddhe bhavet| oloks tu śrīrādāv ātmābhimānād avivekād atasminn api tadbuddhiṃ karotī^ iti na sarvatra vastunirṇaye hetur bhavati||
analyzed: atha api varṇa bhāva bhāvi tvena smṛti saṃskārayoḥ api śabda tvam upacaryeta na etat api tad bhāva bhāvi tvam nāma tasmin eva sati bhavati asti abhāvaḥ eva yatra tatra syāt na ca tat ca varṇānām śabda tve siddhe bhavet tu śrīḥ ādau ātma abhimānāt avivekāt a tasmin api tad buddhim iti na sarvatra vastu nirṇaye hetuḥ bhavati

original: [265,1] api ca vākśrotravyāpāra^ eva saty arthapratipattir iti tasyāvyabhicārāt tadbhāvabhāvitve śabdatvaṃ prāpnoti| tasmād antyo varṇo na vācakaḥ varṇatvāt ādyavarṇavat| tathā tatsmṛtisaṃskārā na vācakāḥ smṛtisaṃskāratvāt ādyavarṇasmṛtisaṃskāravat||
analyzed: api ca vāc śrotra vyāpāre eva sati artha pratipattiḥ iti tasya avyabhicārāt tad bhāva bhāvi tve śabda tvam prāpnoti tasmāt antyaḥ varṇaḥ na vācakaḥ varṇa tvāt ādya varṇa vat tathā tad smṛti saṃskārāḥ na vācakāḥ smṛti saṃskāra tvāt ādya varṇa smṛti saṃskāra vat

original: [265,5] yadi cāntyo varṇaḥ pūrvavarṇajanitasaṃskārasahitaḥ vācaka ity ucyate naitad evam| kasmāt antyavarṇoccaraṇamātrād evārthapratyayaprasaṅgāt| katham atītadivasoccaritagakārādivarṇāhitasaṃskāro hi samastaḥ śrotā| tatrāntyovrṇoccāraṇamātrād arthaḥ pratīyeta|
analyzed: yadi ca antyaḥ varṇaḥ pūrva varṇa janita saṃskāra sahitaḥ vācakaḥ iti ucyate na etat evam kasmāt antya varṇa uccaraṇa mātrāt eva artha pratyaya prasaṅgāt katham atīta divasa uccarita gakāra ādi varṇa āhita saṃskāraḥ hi samastaḥ śrotā tatra antyaḥ vrṇa uccāraṇa mātrāt arthaḥ pratīyeta

original: athāpi niyamārtham ādyavarṇoccāraṇam iti cet na pūrvavarṇānāṃ paścimabarṇenātulyakālatvāt sāhāyakābhāve niyamānupapattiḥ||
analyzed: atha api niyama artham ādya varṇa uccāraṇam iti ced na pūrva varṇānām paścima barṇena atulya kāla tvāt sāhāyaka abhāve niyama anupapattiḥ

original: [265,10] tavāpi varṇānāṃ padavyañjakatve niyamārthaṃ pūrvavarṇā uccāraitavyā iti doṣa^ eva^ iti padavyañjakatvakalpanāto varṇānām eva vācakatvaṃ yuktam iti cet na varṇānāṃ buddhau svakīyasaṃskārādhānamātrābhyupagamāt|  uccaritapradhvaṃsamānavarṇasaṃskāraparaṃparopacitāyāṃ hi buddhau padaṃ nirbhāsate|
analyzed: tava api varṇānām pada vyañjaka tve niyama artham pūrva varṇāḥ iti doṣaḥ eva iti pada vyañjaka tva kalpanātaḥ varṇānām eva vācaka tvam yuktam iti ced na varṇānām buddhau svakīya saṃskāra ādhāna mātra abhyupagamāt uccarita pradhvaṃsamāna varṇa saṃskāra paraṃparā upacitāyām hi buddhau padam nirbhāsate

original: etad eva hi varṇānāṃ padavyañjakatvam na padaṃ prati dīpavat sākṣāt pravartate||
analyzed: etat eva hi varṇānām pada vyañjaka tvam na padam prati dīpa vat sākṣāt pravartate

original: [265,15] na buddhau dharmidvāreṇā saṃskārānām ekāśrayāvasthānād anyonyopakāryopakārakabhāvaḥ samīcīnataraḥ|  iṣṭāniṣṭaviṣayopalabdhismṛtīcchādveṣādivat| na kadācid antyena varṇena pūrvavarṇānāṃ tadīyasmṛtisaṃsārāṇāṃ vā sambandha^ upakalpate||
analyzed: na buddhau dharmi dvāreṇa saṃskārānām eka āśraya avasthānāt anyonya upakārya upakāraka bhāvaḥ samīcīnataraḥ iṣṭa aniṣṭa viṣaya upalabdhi smṛti icchā dveṣa ādi vat na kadācid antyena varṇena pūrva varṇānām tadīya smṛti saṃsārāṇām vā sambandhaḥ upakalpate

original: [265,18] atha mamāpi niyatakramavarṇasampādit-asaṃskāraparamparopacitabuddhyutpādakatvena^ eva varṇānāṃ vācakatvam iti cet nābhyupetaparivarjanāt| yadi tāvad varṇānekasaṃskāraviśiṣṭā buddhiḥ arthaviṣayā vā padaviṣayā vā tathāpi padārthapratipattir iti vādhyeta||
analyzed: atha mama api niyata krama varṇa sampādita saṃskāra paramparā upacita buddhi utpādaka tvena eva varṇānām vācaka tvam iti ced na abhyupeta parivarjanāt yadi tāvat varṇa aneka saṃskāra viśiṣṭā buddhiḥ artha viṣayā vā pada viṣayā vā tathā api padārtha pratipattiḥ iti vādhyeta

original: [265,22] tasmād ekabuddhiviayo varṇavyatiriktaḥ śabdo 'bhyupagantavyaḥ|  tena pūrvavarṇajanitasaṃskārasahito 'ntyo varṇaḥ tatsmṛtiḥ saṃskāro vā na vācakaḥ| saṃskārasāhāyakāpekṣatvāt buddhivat||
analyzed: tasmāt eka buddhi viayaḥ varṇa vyatiriktaḥ śabdaḥ bhyupagantavyaḥ tena pūrva varṇa janita saṃskāra sahitaḥ ntyaḥ varṇaḥ tad smṛtiḥ saṃskāraḥ vā na vācakaḥ saṃskāra sāhāyaka apekṣa tvāt buddhi vat

original: [265,25] evaṃ gate katham varṇānām arthaviṣayaḥ padaviṣayo vā vyāpāro nāstīty āha varṇāḥ ekasamayāsambhavitvāt| ekakālasambhavitvaṃ ca vācaḥ kramavartitvāt| ataḥ parasparaniranugrahātmānaḥ kasyacid abhisambandhasyābhāvād itaretaranirupakārāḥ|
analyzed: evam gate katham varṇānām artha viṣayaḥ pada viṣayaḥ vā vyāpāraḥ na asti iti āha varṇāḥ eka samaya asambhavi tvāt eka kāla sambhavi tvam ca vācaḥ krama varti tvāt atas paraspara niranugraha ātmānaḥ kasyacid abhisambandhasya abhāvāt itaretara nirupakārāḥ

original: te padam anupasaṃspṛśyānupasthāpya kañcana pade vyāpāram avhidhāya^ āvir-bhūtāś ca tirobhūtāś ca vyastā vā samastā vā na padātmānam apāṅgavikṣepeṇāpi parāmṛśanti| pratyekam apadasvarūpāḥ yugapad anavasthānāt samudāyātmanā apy apadasvarūpā eva| kimaṅga punaḥ pratyekam anarthakānām avasthitānām iti||
analyzed: te padam an upasaṃspṛśya an upasthāpya kañcana pade vyāpāram avhidhāya āvirbhūtāḥ ca tirobhūtāḥ ca vyastāḥ vā samastāḥ vā na pada ātmānam apāṅga vikṣepeṇa api parāmṛśanti pratyekam apada svarūpāḥ yugapad anavasthānāt samudāya ātmanā api apada svarūpāḥ eva kim aṅga punar pratyekam anarthakānām avasthitānām iti

original: [266,14] varṇaḥ punar ekaikaḥ sarvābhidhānaśaktipracitaḥ| abhidhīyate yaiḥ tāny abhidhānāni padāni teṣāṃ sarveṣām abhidhānānāṃ padānām abhivyañjikābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ pracītaḥ arāṇām ekaika^ iva nābhau| tadyathā gakāraḥ kovargāgnigaganādisarvapadābhidyotanasāmarthyapracitaḥ||
analyzed: varṇaḥ punar ekaikaḥ sarva abhidhāna śakti pracitaḥ abhidhīyate yaiḥ tāni abhidhānāni padāni teṣām sarveṣām abhidhānānām padānām abhivyañjikābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ pracītaḥ arāṇām ekaikaḥ iva nābhau tat yathā gakāraḥ kovarga agni gagana ādi sarva pada abhidyotana sāmarthya pracitaḥ

original: [266,18] sahakārivarṇāntarapratiyogitvāt| yathā gaur iti gakārāu-kāravisarjanīyasahakārisavyapekṣaḥ agnir itīkārapratiyogī|  tasmād anekavarṇāntaropādhisambandhāt pratipadaṃ vaiśvarūpyam ivāpannaḥ| uttaraś ca varṇaḥ pūrveṇa viśeṣe padaviśeṣapradyotane avasthāpitaḥ| pūrvaś cottareṇa madhyamo api pūrvottarābhyām||
analyzed: sahakāri varṇa antara pratiyogi tvāt yathā gauḥ iti gakāra aukāra visarjanīya sahakāri sa vyapekṣaḥ agniḥ iti ikāra pratiyogī tasmāt aneka varṇa antara upādhi sambandhāt pratipadam vaiśvarūpyam iva āpannaḥ uttaraḥ ca varṇaḥ pūrveṇa viśeṣe pada viśeṣa pradyotane avasthāpitaḥ pūrvaḥ ca uttareṇa madhyamaḥ api pūrva uttarābhyām

original: [266,22] evaṃ bahavo varṇāḥ kramānurodhinaḥ viśiṣṭakramaṃ ānupūrvīm anurudhyamānāḥ||
analyzed: evam bahavaḥ varṇāḥ krama anurodhinaḥ viśiṣṭa kramam ānupūrvīm anurudhyamānāḥ

analyzed: tad vairāgyāt api doṣa bīja kṣaye kaivalyam yadā asya evam bhavati sarvajñasya sarva bhāvān adhitiṣṭhataḥ kleśa karma kṣaye vivekī sattvasya pratyayaḥ puruṣaḥ ca sattva vidharmā apariṇāmī śuddhaḥ sattvāt iti anena prakāreṇa

original: [307,17] sthānyupamantraṇe saṅgasmayākaraṇaṃ punar aniṣṭaprasaṅgāt| sthānaṃ svargādikaṃ yeṣān te sthānino devā indrādayaḥ| taiḥ upamantraṇaṃ bho bho^ ihoṣyatām ityādi| tasmin satyātmano hīnatvaṃ smarataḥ prāpnutaḥ saṅgasmayau (arthād iti) tau ca na kartavyau| saṅgasmayakaraṇe 'niṣṭaṃ prasajyeta||
analyzed: sthāni upamantraṇe saṅga smaya akaraṇam punar aniṣṭa prasaṅgāt sthānam svarga ādikam yeṣām te sthāninaḥ devāḥ indra ādayaḥ taiḥ upamantraṇam bho bho iha uṣyatām ityādi tasmin sati ātmanaḥ hīna tvam smarataḥ prāpnutaḥ saṅga smayau arthāt iti tau ca na kartavyau saṅga smaya karaṇe niṣṭam prasajyeta

analyzed: ṛtambharaprajñaḥ dvitīyaḥ bhūtendriyajayī tṛtīyaḥ sa tu sarveṣu bhāviteṣu bhāvanīyeṣu sākṣāt kṛteṣu jiteṣu ca kṛta rakṣā bandhaḥ upāttasya hi rakṣā vidhānīyā bhāvanīyeṣu sākṣāt karaṇīyeṣu kartavyatā sādhanavān ca kartavyatāyāḥ sādhanāni kartavyatā sādhanāni abhyāsa vairāgya ādīni yasya saḥ kartavyatā sādhanavān

original: [308,24] yas tv atikrāntabhāvanīyaś caturthaḥ tasya cittapratisarga^ eva cittapralaya^ eva^ eko 'rthaḥ pariśiṣṭaḥ| saptavidhā tasya prāntabhūmim

original: prajñā| tatra madhumatīṃ bhūmiṃ dvitīyām ṛtaṃbharaprajñābhūmiṃ sākṣātkurvato brāhmāṇasya sthānino devāḥ sattvaviśuddhimanupaśyantaḥ sthānair upamantrayante| bhoḥ ityādi prasiddhārthaṃ bhāṣyam||3.51||
analyzed: prajñā tatra madhumatīm bhūmim dvitīyām ṛtaṃbhara prajñā bhūmim sākṣātkurvataḥ brāhmāṇasya sthāninaḥ devāḥ sattva viśuddhim anupaśyantaḥ sthānaiḥ upamantrayante bhoḥ ityādi prasiddha artham bhāṣyam

original: [309,9] kṣaṇatatkramayoḥ saṃyamād vivekajaṃ jñānaṃ| kṣaṇaṃ kramaṃ ca svayam eva vistareṇācaṣṭe tatrāpakarṣaparyantaṃ yataḥ param apakarṣo na śakyate kartuṃ tad-dravyaṃ paramāṇuḥ| evaṃ lokabudhivikalpitād ahorātralakṣaṇād apakṛṣyamāṇāt kālād alpīyaḥ parijighṛkṣayā yataḥ param apakraṣṭuṃ na śakyate saḥ apakarṣaparyantaḥ kālaḥ kṣaṇaḥ vastubhūtaḥ||
analyzed: kṣaṇa tad kramayoḥ saṃyamāt viveka jam jñānam kṣaṇam kramam ca svayam eva vistareṇa ācaṣṭe tatra apakarṣa paryantam yatas param apakarṣaḥ na śakyate kartum tat dravyam paramāṇuḥ evam loka budhi vikalpitāt ahar rātra lakṣaṇāt apakṛṣyamāṇāt kālāt alpīyaḥ parijighṛkṣayā yatas param apakraṣṭum na śakyate saḥ apakarṣa paryantaḥ kālaḥ kṣaṇaḥ vastu bhūtaḥ

original: [309,14] yad vā yāvatā samayena vicalitaḥ paramāṇuḥ pūrvaṃ deśaṃ jahyād uttaram abhisaṃpadyeta sa kālaḥ kṣaṇaḥ| sarvathā 'yu^ asti (sūkṣma)kṣaṇa ity arthaḥ||
analyzed: yat vā yāvatā samayena vicalitaḥ paramāṇuḥ pūrvam deśam jahyāt uttaram abhisaṃpadyeta sa kālaḥ kṣaṇaḥ sarvathā asti sūkṣma kṣaṇaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: [309,16] tasya pravāhavicchedabhāvinaḥ tasya kṣaṇasya pravāhaḥ prabandhaḥ avidhedo nairantaryaṃ tathā bhavituṃ śīlaṃ yasya kṣaṇasya
analyzed: tasya pravāha viccheda bhāvinaḥ tasya kṣaṇasya pravāhaḥ prabandhaḥ a vidhedaḥ nairantaryam tathā bhavitum śīlam yasya kṣaṇasya

original: pravāhāvicchedabhāvinaḥ kṣaṇasya yat ānantaryaṃ saḥ kṣaṇasya kramaḥ| tayoś ca kṣaṇatatkramayor nāsti vastusamāhāraḥ kṣaṇakramasyāvastutvāt kṣaṇasya ca^ ekatvāt nāsti tayoḥ samāhāraḥ samūhaḥ||
analyzed: pravāha aviccheda bhāvinaḥ kṣaṇasya yat ānantaryam saḥ kṣaṇasya kramaḥ tayoḥ ca kṣaṇa tad kramayoḥ na asti vastu samāhāraḥ kṣaṇa kramasya avastu tvāt kṣaṇasya ca ekatvāt na asti tayoḥ samāhāraḥ samūhaḥ

original: pravarterann iti tadartham āha buddhisamāhārāt buddhiparikalpitāt kṣaṇatatkramayoḥ samāhārādād ityādideśāntarasaṃbandhāvabandhabuddhisamudbhāvitāt muhūrtāhorātrādayaḥ| tataś ca buddhisthita^ eṣa bhedaḥ||

original: [309,24] yo hi prasannasamānapratyayavāhinasaḥ ekāgrabhūmipratiṣṭhicittasattvaḥ tasya saty api kālānubhave kṣaṇayugasahasrayos tulyatā| na^ evaṃ vyutthitacittasya| tathā svapne api ghaṭikāmātreṇa buddhiparikalpitaṃ yojanasahasram anekaṃ saṃvatsareṇa^ eva [gantavyaṃ] gaddhati| tasmād buddhivaicitryanimrmita^ eva kālasamāhāraḥ||
analyzed: yaḥ hi ekāgra bhūmi pratiṣṭhi citta sattvaḥ tasya sati api kāla anubhave kṣaṇa yuga sahasrayoḥ tulya tā na evam vyutthita cittasya tathā svapne api ghaṭikā mātreṇa buddhi parikalpitam yojana sahasram anekam saṃvatsareṇa eva gantavyam tasmāt buddhi vaicitrya nimrmitaḥ eva kāla samāhāraḥ

original: [310,6] yasya tu kriyāvyatiriktaḥ kālaḥ nityo vibhuḥ tasya cirakṣipratvādy api kriyāmātre paryavasitatvāt pṛthakkālāstitvena liṅgaṃ ghaṭate| niyataparimāṇā hi kriyānavagatapariṇāmāyāḥ kriyāyā lakṣaṇam| yathāgodohanaṃ svapiti| odanapākam adhīte^ iti| sa^ eva ca kālaḥ|
analyzed: yasya tu kriyā vyatiriktaḥ kālaḥ nityaḥ vibhuḥ tasya cira kṣipra tva ādi api kriyā mātre paryavasita tvāt pṛthak kāla astitvena liṅgam ghaṭate niyata parimāṇā hi kriyā anavagata pariṇāmāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ lakṣaṇam yathā godohanam svapiti odana pākam adhīte iti saḥ eva ca kālaḥ

original: na hi nityasya vibhoḥ tasya kūṭasthasyāsambandhatvāt vastvantaraparicchedakatvaṃ prasthādivad upapadyate ||

original: [310,11] kriyāvān kālaḥ paricchedakaḥ prasthādivad iti cet tasyāpi kriyāvattvāt kriyāvataś ca pariddhedanīyatvād anyena kriyāvatā
analyzed: kriyāvān kālaḥ paricchedakaḥ prastha ādi vat iti ced tasya api kriyāvat tvāt kriyāvataḥ ca pariddhedanīya tvāt anyena kriyāvatā

original: [310,14] atha svavyāpāreṇa^ eva kālaḥ paricchedanīyakaṃ yāyād iti cet anye api svavyāpāreṇa^ eva paricchedyā iti kālapṛthaktvakalpāa nirarthikā| tathā ca kriyā^ evāstu kālaḥ||
analyzed: atha sva vyāpāreṇa eva kālaḥ paricchedanīyakam yāyāt iti ced anye api sva vyāpāreṇa eva paricchedyāḥ iti kāla pṛthaktva kalpā nirarthikā tathā ca kriyā eva astu kālaḥ

original: [310,17] athāpi sadbhāvamātreṇa kālaḥ paricchedaka^ iti sarveṣām api sadbhāvāviśeṣād evaṃ prasaktam||

original: [310,19] kriyākālapakṣe apy eṣa vikalpaḥ prāpta^ iti cet na kriyāyāḥ sarvaprasiddhatvāt| paricchedakatvasya ca^ ā godohamās te^ ityādiṣu siddhatvāt kriyā^ eva pricchedikā labhyate nāparaḥ kālaḥ pariddhedaka^ iti|
analyzed: kriyā kāla pakṣe api eṣa vikalpaḥ prāptaḥ iti ced na kriyāyāḥ sarva prasiddha tvāt paricchedaka tvasya ca ā godohamāḥ te ityādiṣu siddha tvāt kriyā eva pricchedikā labhyate na aparaḥ kālaḥ pariddhedakaḥ iti

original: ciraṃ kṣipram iti ca prayatnamandimapāṭavakṛtaḥ pratyayo na vyatiriktakālanibandhana^ ity āha sa khalv ayaṃ kālaḥ saṃvatsarādirūpo vastuśūnyo buddhinirmāṇaḥ buddhyā nirmāpiṣyate||
analyzed: ciram kṣipram iti ca prayatna mandima pāṭava kṛtaḥ pratyayaḥ na vyatirikta kāla nibandhanaḥ iti āha sa khalu ayam kālaḥ saṃvatsara ādi rūpaḥ vastu śūnyaḥ buddhi nirmāṇaḥ buddhyā nirmāpiṣyate

original: [310,24] śabdadharmānupātī truṭinimeṣāhorātrādiśabdavikalpānupravartī|  laukikānāṃ vyutthitadarśanānāṃ vastusvarūpa^ ivābhāsate| kṣaṇas tu vasturūpaḥ vāstavikaḥ taddravyānyathātveenānumīyamānaḥ kramāvalambī|  kramaś ca kṣaṇānantaryātmā kṣaṇapravāhāviddhedabuddhinimittaḥ||
analyzed: śabda dharma anupātī truṭi nimeṣa ahar rātra ādi śabda vikalpa anupravartī laukikānām vyutthita darśanānām vastu svarūpaḥ iva ābhāsate kṣaṇaḥ tu vastu rūpaḥ vāstavikaḥ krama avalambī kramaḥ ca kṣaṇa ānantarya ātmā kṣaṇa pravāha āviddha idam buddhi nimittaḥ

original: [311,10] taṃ kṣaṇaṃ kālavidaḥ kāla^ ity ācakṣate yoginaḥ| na ca dvau kṣaṇau saha bhavataḥ yayoḥ samāhāraḥ kalpyeta| ekasmin dharmiṇi sahajanmanoḥ kṣaṇayor asaṃbhavāt| jāyamāno hi caitra^ ekasmin kṣaṇe jāyate| na tatra dvau kaṇau saha bhavataḥ| kramaś ca na dvayoḥ| kasmāt dvayoḥ kṣaṇayoḥ sahabhuvorāsambhavāt ||
analyzed: tam kṣaṇam kāla vidaḥ kālaḥ iti ācakṣate yoginaḥ na ca dvau kṣaṇau saha bhavataḥ yayoḥ samāhāraḥ kalpyeta ekasmin dharmiṇi sahajanmanoḥ kṣaṇayoḥ asaṃbhavāt jāyamānaḥ hi caitraḥ ekasmin kṣaṇe jāyate na tatra dvau kaṇau saha bhavataḥ kramaḥ ca na dvayoḥ kasmāt dvayoḥ kṣaṇayoḥ sahabhuvoḥ āsambhavāt

original: [311,14] pūrvasmād uttarasya bhāvino yad^ ānantaryaṃ kṣaṇasya sa kramaḥ|  yathā piṇḍād uttarabhāvino ghaṭasya yad^ ānantaryaṃ sa kramaḥ| na hi cakrāntarasthasya mṛt-piṇḍasya cakrāntarasthamṛtpiṇḍajanito ghaṭaḥ krame vartate| tasmād vartamāna^ ekaikaḥ kṣaṇaḥ| na pūrvottarāv atītānāgatau staḥ pūrvottarayor dharmisvarūpamātratvāt|
analyzed: pūrvasmāt uttarasya bhāvinaḥ yat ānantaryam kṣaṇasya sa kramaḥ yathā piṇḍāt uttara bhāvinaḥ ghaṭasya yat ānantaryam sa kramaḥ na hi cakra antara sthasya mṛd piṇḍasya cakra antara stha mṛd piṇḍa janitaḥ ghaṭaḥ krame vartate tasmāt vartamānaḥ ekaikaḥ kṣaṇaḥ na pūrva uttarau atīta anāgatau staḥ pūrva uttarayoḥ dharmi svarūpa mātra tvāt

original: dharmī ca vartamānakṣaṇārūḍha^ eva| tasmānnityā nāsti tatsamāhāraḥ kṣaṇatatkramasamāhāraḥ||
