original: [361,18] tatrātmabhāvabhāvanā kā punar ity āha ko 'ham āsaṃ katham aham āsaṃ kiṃsvid idaṃ kathaṃsvid idaṃ ke bhaviṣyāmaḥ kathaṃ bhaviṣyāmaḥ iti| sā tu viśeṣadarśino nivartate| yadviṣayā hi jijñāsā tasminn adhigate tadviṣayā jijñāsā vinivartate| kutaḥ etad evam yataḥ cittasya^ evaiṣaḥ ke bhaviṣyāma^ ity ādiḥ citraḥ pariṇāmaḥ na puruṣasya|
analyzed: tatra ātma bhāva bhāvanā kā punar iti āha kaḥ ham āsam katham aham āsam kim svid idam katham svid idam ke bhaviṣyāmaḥ katham bhaviṣyāmaḥ iti sā tu viśeṣa darśiṇaḥ nivartate yad viṣayā hi jijñāsā tasmin adhigate tad viṣayā jijñāsā vinivartate kutas etat evam yatas cittasya eva eṣaḥ ke bhaviṣyāmaḥ iti ādiḥ citraḥ pariṇāmaḥ na puruṣasya

original: puruṣatvasatyām avidyāyāṃ śuddhaś cittadharmair aprāmṛṣṭa^ iti| yasmād evam ata^ evaṃ viśeṣadarśinaḥ tasyātmabhāvabhāvanā kuśalasya nirvartate||4.25||
analyzed: puruṣa tva satyām avidyāyām śuddhaḥ citta dharmaiḥ aprāmṛṣṭaḥ iti yasmāt evam atas evam viśeṣa darśinaḥ tasya ātma bhāva bhāvanā kuśalasya nirvartate

original: [361,24] yadā ca viśeṣadarśanam udapādi tadā vivekanimnaṃ kaivalyaprāgbhāraṃ cittaṃ| yad^ asya cittaṃ viṣayanimnaṃ viṣayapravaṇam ajñānaprāgbhāram ajñānaniṣṭhaṃ saṃsārābhimukham āsīt tad asya viśeṣadarśinaḥ tadānīm anyathā  bhavati kaivalyamrāgbhāraṃ vivekanimnam iti pratisnotovṛttir jñāyate||4.26||
analyzed: yadā ca viśeṣa darśanam udapādi tadā viveka nimnam kaivalya prāgbhāram cittam yat asya cittam viṣaya nimnam viṣaya pravaṇam ajñāna prāgbhāram ajñāna niṣṭham saṃsāra abhimukham āsīt tat asya viśeṣa darśinaḥ tadānīm anyathā bhavati kaivalya mrāgbhāram viveka nimnam iti prati snotas vṛttiḥ jñāyate

original: [362,14] tac chidreṣu pratyayāntarāṇi saṃskārebhyaḥ| vivekanimnasya uttarottaravivekapravaṇacetasaḥ puruṣasya jñāninaḥ anyatākhyātipravāhādhirohiṇaḥ sattvapuruṣānyatāsrotaḥplāvinaḥ cittasya tacchidreṣu vivekapratyayapravāhāntareṣu pratyayāntarāṇi viparyayalakṣaṇāni^ asmīti vā mameti vā|
analyzed: tat chidreṣu pratyaya antarāṇi saṃskārebhyaḥ viveka nimnasya uttara uttara viveka pravaṇa cetasaḥ puruṣasya jñāninaḥ anyatā khyāti pravāha adhirohiṇaḥ sattva puruṣa anyatā srotaḥ plāvinaḥ cittasya tad chidreṣu viveka pratyaya pravāha antareṣu pratyaya antarāṇi viparyaya lakṣaṇāni asmi iti vā mama iti vā

original: kkutaḥ tāni bhavantīty āha kṣīyamāṇakleśādibījasya cittasya pūrvopacitaviparītasaṃskārebhyaḥ
analyzed: kkutas tāni bhavanti iti āha kṣīyamāṇa kleśa ādi bījasya cittasya pūrva upacita viparīta saṃskārebhyaḥ

original: pratyayāntarāṇi jāyante||4.27||
analyzed: pratyaya antarāṇi jāyante

original: [362,20] hānam eṣāṃ kleśavad uktam| yathā kleśā dagdhabījabhāvā na parohasamarthā bhavantīti te pratiprasabaheyāḥ sūkṣmāḥ ity atroktam evaṃ jñānāgnidagdhabījabhāvāḥ asmi mametyādipratyayasaṃskārā na parohasamarthā bhavanti| dagdhaśālibījavat pūrvasaṃskāro na pratyayaprasūrbhavatīty arthaḥ||
analyzed: hānam eṣām kleśa vat uktam yathā kleśāḥ dagdha bīja bhāvāḥ na paroha samarthāḥ bhavanti iti te pratiprasaba heyāḥ sūkṣmāḥ iti atra uktam evam jñāna agni dagdha bīja bhāvāḥ asmi mama ityādi pratyaya saṃskārāḥ na paroha samarthāḥ bhavanti dagdha śāli bīja vat pūrva saṃskāraḥ na pratyaya prasūḥ bhavati iti arthaḥ

original: [362,24] jñānasaṃskārās tu katham apratipakṣāḥ santaś cittam adhikāre na(bīja)yojayiṣyantīti te tu samyagdarśanasaṃskārāś cittādhikāraparisamāptim anuśerate| jsahaivāśrayeṇāvasitaprayojanena cittena pralīyante| na punaś cittam adhikārapravaṇaṃ kkurvanti| adhikārahetor avidyāyāḥ pratipakṣatvāj jñānasya| tyatra niṣphalatvāt na vintyante|
analyzed: jñāna saṃskārāḥ tu katham a pratipakṣāḥ santaḥ cittam adhikāre iti te tu samyagdarśana saṃskārāḥ citta adhikāra parisamāptim anuśerate saha eva āśrayeṇa avasita prayojanena cittena pralīyante na punar cittam adhikāra pravaṇam kurvanti adhikāra hetoḥ avidyāyāḥ pratipakṣa tvāt jñānasya niṣphala tvāt na vintyante

original: na hi svayaṃ patataḥ patanahetur anbeṣaṇīyaḥ||4.28||
analyzed: na hi svayam patataḥ patana hetuḥ anbeṣaṇīyaḥ

original: [363,15] vivekakhyātipravaṇāntaḥkaraṇasya brāhmāṇasya prasṃkhyāne apy akusīd asya sarvathāvivekakhyāter dharmamedhaḥ samādhiḥ| sa yadā^ ayaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ prasṃkhyāne vivekadarśanaśīlite apy akusīdaṅ avṛddhiko bhavati tato api prasaṃkhyānaprāsādaviśeṣād adhikaṃ na kiṃcit prārthayate| apiśabdāt prasṃkhyāne api na prārthanā|
analyzed: viveka khyāti pravaṇa antaḥkaraṇasya brāhmāṇasya prasṃkhyāne api a kusīd asya sarvathā viveka khyāteḥ dharmamedhaḥ samādhiḥ sa yadā ayam brāhmaṇaḥ prasṃkhyāne viveka darśana śīlite api a kusīdaṅ a vṛddhikaḥ bhavati tatas api prasaṃkhyāna prāsāda viśeṣāt adhikam na kiṃcid prārthayate apiśabdāt prasṃkhyāne api na prārthanā

original: tatra_Pi prasṃkhyāne viraktaḥ| sarvathā sarveṇa prakāreṇa vivekakhyātir yasya sa sarvathāvivekakhyātir eva bhavati||
analyzed: tatra prasṃkhyāne viraktaḥ sarvathā sarveṇa prakāreṇa viveka khyātiḥ yasya sa sarvathā viveka khyātiḥ eva bhavati

original: [363,21] kleśasaṃskārabījakṣayāt nāsya śarīrādau śūnyeveśmanīvāsmi mameti vā jñānaprasādamātraikāyatanasya pratyayāntarāṇy utpadyante| tadā 'sya brāhmāṇasya sarvathāvivekakhyāteḥ dharmamegho nāma samādhir bhavati| kaivalyākhyaṃ paraṃ dharmaṃ varṣatīti dharmameghaḥ iti saṃjñā||4.29||
analyzed: kleśa saṃskāra bīja kṣayāt na asya śarīra ādau śūnye iva īśmani iva asmi mama iti vā jñāna prasāda mātra eka āyatanasya pratyaya antarāṇi utpadyante tadā brāhmāṇasya sarvathā viveka khyāteḥ dharmameghaḥ nāma samādhiḥ bhavati kaivalya ākhyam param dharmam varṣati iti dharmameghaḥ iti saṃjñā

original: [363,25] tataḥ kleśakarmanivṛttiḥ| tasya dharmamedhanāmnaḥ samādheḥ samyagdarśanapākābhirūpasya [lābhāt] bhāvāt abidyādayaḥ kleśāḥ samūlakāṣaṃ kaṣitāḥ vāsanābhiḥ saha samastāḥ pralīnāḥ bhavanti| kuśalākuśśalāś ca karmāśayāḥ samūlaghātaṃ hatā bhavanti| mūlaiḥ kleśaiḥ sahocchinnā bhavanti||
analyzed: tatas kleśa karma nivṛttiḥ tasya dharmamedha nāmnaḥ samādheḥ samyagdarśana pāka abhirūpasya lābhāt bhāvāt abidyā ādayaḥ kleśāḥ sa mūla kāṣam kaṣitāḥ vāsanābhiḥ saha samastāḥ pralīnāḥ bhavanti kuśala a kuśśalāḥ ca karma āśayāḥ sa mūla ghātam hatāḥ bhavanti mūlaiḥ kleśaiḥ saha ucchinnāḥ bhavanti

original: [364,15] kleśakarmanivṛttau jīvann eva vidvān mukto bhavati| kasmāt evam yato viparyayaḥ mithyājñānaṃ bhavasya janmanaḥ kāraṇam| na hi kṣīṇaviparyayaḥ kaścit kvacij jāto dṛśyate||3.30||
analyzed: kleśa karma nivṛttau jīvan eva vidvān muktaḥ bhavati kasmāt evam yatas viparyayaḥ mithyājñānam bhavasya janmanaḥ kāraṇam na hi kṣīṇa viparyayaḥ kaścid kvacid jātaḥ dṛśyate

original: [364,18] tadā sarvāvaraṇamalāpetasya jñānasyānantyāt jñeyam alpam| tadā dharmamedhasamādhisamaye sarvaiḥ kleśakarmāvaraṇaiḥ rajastamojanmabhiḥ vimuktasya jñānasya sattvapuruṣānyatākhyātimātrasya bhavaty ānantyam|
analyzed: tadā sarva āvaraṇa mala apetasya jñānasya ānantyāt jñeyam alpam tadā dharma medha samādhi samaye sarvaiḥ kleśa karma āvaraṇaiḥ rajaḥ tamaḥ janmabhiḥ vimuktasya jñānasya sattva puruṣa anya tā khyāti mātrasya bhavati ānantyam

original: tat katham iti tamasā(na)bhibhūtam anantaṃ jñānasattvaṃ tasya tiraskṛtarajomalasyānantasya nistaraṅgamahodadhideśīyasya nirahitasyāvikriyasya kathaṃ tad-grahāṇasāmarthyam ityāha kvacid rajasā
analyzed: tat katham iti tamasā anabhibhūtam anantam jñāna sattvam tasya tiraskṛta rajaḥ malasya anantasya nistaraṅga mahodadhi deśīyasya nirahitasya avikriyasya katham tad grahāṇa sāmarthyam iti āha kvacid rajasā

original: pravartitaṃ cittasattvam uddhāṭitaṃ vāyuneva mahāpayodamaṇḍalam āhataṃ cūcitaṃ grahaṇasamarthaṃ bhavvati| svataḥ sattvasyāpravartanāt rajaso hiḥ
analyzed: pravartitam citta sattvam uddhāṭitam vāyunā iva mahā payoda maṇḍalam āhatam cūcitam grahaṇa samartham bhavvati svatas sattvasya a pravartanāt rajasaḥ hiḥ

original: pravṛttisāmarthyam iti||
analyzed: pravṛtti sāmarthyam iti

original: [364,25] tadāsya cittasya bhavaty ānantyam aśeṣajñeyaviṣayatvam ambaratalamadhyavartino jaladharanirodhanirgatasya sver iva| tasya jñānasyānantyā^ aśeṣaviṣayatvāt jñeyam alpaṃ saṃpadyate| yathā^ ākāśe khadyotaḥ iti| yathā^ ākāśāpekṣayā khadyoto na kiṃcid evam etajjñānābhisamīkṣayā jñeyaṃ na kiṃcid iti||
analyzed: tadā asya cittasya bhavati ānantyam aśeṣa jñeya viṣaya tvam ambara tala madhya vartinaḥ jaladhara nirodha nirgatasya sveḥ iva tasya jñānasya ānantyā aśeṣa viṣaya tvāt jñeyam alpam saṃpadyate yathā ākāśe khadyotaḥ iti yathā ākāśa apekṣayā khadyotaḥ na kiṃcid evam etat jñāna abhisamīkṣayā jñeyam na kiṃcid iti

original: [365,15] paramārthajñānāvasthāyām aśeṣabiparyayatirodhāne sarvapuruṣārthaśūnyatā cety etatpradarśanārtham udāharaṇam āha yatredam uktam andho maṇim avindat (dhyat) tam anaṅgulirāvayat| agrīvaḥ [taṃ] pratyamuñcat tamajihvo 'bhyapūjayat || iti|
analyzed: paramārtha jñāna avasthāyām aśeṣa biparyaya tirodhāne sarva puruṣa artha śūnyatā ca iti etad pradarśana artham udāharaṇam āha yatra idam uktam andhaḥ maṇim avindat tam anaṅguliḥ āvayat agrīvaḥ tam pratyamuñcat tam ajihvaḥ bhyapūjayat iti

original: yathā^ andha^ādīnāṃ maṇīvedhādikam asambhavad api viparyayeṇāndho maṇim avidhyad iti vyavahriyate tathā jñānajñeyasaṃvyavahāro api viparyayāvasthāyām eva| viparyayābhāve tu sarvapuruṣārthaśūnyā eva guṇāḥ sampadyanta iti||4.31||
analyzed: yathā andha ādīnām maṇī vedha ādikam asambhavat api viparyayeṇa andhaḥ maṇim avidhyat iti vyavahriyate tathā jñāna jñeya saṃvyavahāraḥ api viparyaya avasthāyām eva viparyaya abhāve tu sarva puruṣa artha śūnyāḥ eva guṇāḥ sampadyante iti

original: [365,21] tataḥ kṛtārthānāṃ pariṇāmakramaparisamāptir guṇānām| tataḥ dharmamedhasamādhisamudayāt kṛtārthāś cittaguṇāḥ sampadyante| cittādhīnatvāc ca kāryakaraṇārambhiṇo api sattvādayaḥ kṛtārthā bhavanti| samastasya puruṣārthasya kṛtatvāt eṣāṃ kṛtārthānāṃ guṇānāṃ janmamaraṇapra(bhāva)vāharūpaḥ pariṇāmakramaḥ parisamāpyate|
analyzed: tatas kṛtārthānām pariṇāma krama parisamāptiḥ guṇānām tatas dharma medha samādhi samudayāt kṛtārthāḥ citta guṇāḥ sampadyante citta adhīna tvāt ca kārya karaṇa ārambhiṇaḥ api sattva ādayaḥ kṛtārthāḥ bhavanti samastasya puruṣa arthasya kṛta tvāt eṣām kṛtārthānām guṇānām janma maraṇa prabhāva vāha rūpaḥ pariṇāma kramaḥ parisamāpyate

original: na hi kṛtabhogāpavargārthāḥ kṣaṇam api prayojanābhāvāt avasthātum utsahante||4.32||
analyzed: na hi kṛta bhoga apavarga arthāḥ kṣaṇam api prayojana abhāvāt avasthātum utsahante

original: [365,27] pariṇāmakramaparisamāptir ity uktam| atha ko 'yaṃ guṇakramo nāma yasya parisamāptir upavarṇitā| tasyāyam adhigamopāya^ ucyate kṣaṇapratiyogī pariṇāmāparāntanirgrāhyaḥ kramaḥ| kṣaṇaṃ prati yujyata iti kṣaṇapratiyogī| (366,8) kṣaṇāntaryātmā kṣaṇasyānantaratā kṣaṇānantaryaṃ tadātmā tatsvabhāvaḥ|
analyzed: pariṇāma krama parisamāptiḥ iti uktam atha kaḥ yam guṇa kramaḥ nāma yasya parisamāptiḥ upavarṇitā tasya ayam adhigama upāyaḥ ucyate kṣaṇa pratiyogī kramaḥ kṣaṇam prati yujyate iti kṣaṇa pratiyogī kṣaṇa āntarya ātmā kṣaṇasya anantaratā kṣaṇa ānantaryam tad ātmā tad svabhāvaḥ

original: kṣaṇānantaryam eva kṣaṇatatkramayoḥ iti vyākhgyātam||
analyzed: kṣaṇa ānantaryam eva kṣaṇa tad kramayoḥ iti

original: [366,10] kiṃ punar asya grahaṇe liṅgam ity āha pariṇāmasyāparāntena vināśāvasthārūpeṇāvasānena liṅgena nigṛhyate saḥ kramaḥ| katham aparāntena nirgrahaṇam iti^ ucyate na hy ananubhūtakramā kramam anavalambamānā kṣaṇe purāṇatā vastrasyānte vināśakāle bhavatīti| na hi kadācidbhūtamātrasya^ eva vastrasya purāṇatā dṛśyate| tasmāt
analyzed: kim punar asya grahaṇe liṅgam iti āha pariṇāmasya apara antena vināśa avasthā rūpeṇa avasānena liṅgena nigṛhyate saḥ kramaḥ katham apara antena nirgrahaṇam iti ucyate na hi ananubhūta kramā kramam an avalambamānā kṣaṇe purāṇa tā vastrasya ante vināśa kāle bhavati iti na hi kadācid bhūta mātrasya eva vastrasya purāṇa tā dṛśyate tasmāt

original: purānatābhivyaktiliṅgenābhyūhyate yeneyaṃ purāṇatā vastrasyābhivyaktim upasaṃprāpitā sa kramaḥ||
analyzed: purā ānata abhivyakti liṅgena abhyūhyate yena iyam purāṇa tā vastrasya abhivyaktim upasaṃprāpitā sa kramaḥ

original: [366,16] tatra yadi labhāvasānatvam alabdhāvasānatvaṃ ca kramasya syāt tato yuktaṃ kṛtārthānāṃ pariṇāmakramaparisamāptir guṇānām iti vaktum| tac ca labdhālabdhāvasānatvaṃ kramasya nityānityatve ghaṭate| tatrānityeṣu vastrādiṣu kramo dṛṣṭaḥ na tu nityeṣu|
analyzed: tatra yadi alabdha avasāna tvam ca kramasya syāt tatas yuktam kṛtārthānām pariṇāma krama parisamāptiḥ guṇānām iti vaktum tat ca labdha alabdha avasāna tvam kramasya nitya anitya tve ghaṭate tatra anityeṣu vastra ādiṣu kramaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ na tu nityeṣu

original: tataś ca guṇānāṃ nityānāṃ pariṇāmakramaprisamāptir ayuktā syād ity āśaṅkamāna^ āha nityeṣu ca kramo dṛṣṭaḥ kiṃ sarvatra nety āha dvividheyaṃ nityatā pariṇāmanityatā guṇānāṃ kūṭasthanityatā puruṣasya^ iti||
analyzed: tatas ca guṇānām nityānām pariṇāma krama prisamāptiḥ ayuktā syāt iti āśaṅkamānaḥ āha nityeṣu ca kramaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ kim sarvatra na iti āha dvividhā iyam nitya tā pariṇāma nitya tā guṇānām kūṭastha nitya tā puruṣasya iti

original: [366,22] nanu pariṇāmināṃ guṇānāṃ kathaṃ nityatā syād iti vravīti yasmin pariṇammāne tattvaṃ na vihanyate| yasya yadrūpaṃ pramāṇena^ upalabdhaṃ tasya tat tattvam| yadyasmin na vihanyate na vyabhicarati tad api nityam| guṇānām api sukhaduḥkhamohātmatā prakāśakriyāsthitiśīlatā ca tattvaṃ na vihanyate| tasmād ete api pariṇāmanityāḥ|
analyzed: nanu pariṇāminām guṇānām katham nitya tā syāt iti vravīti yasmin pariṇammāne tattvam na vihanyate yasya yat rūpam pramāṇena upalabdham tasya tat tattvam yat yasmin na vihanyate na vyabhicarati tat api nityam guṇānām api sukha duḥkha moha ātma tā prakāśa kriyā sthiti śīla tā ca tattvam na vihanyate tasmāt ete api pariṇāma nityāḥ

original: ubhayatra ca guṇāpuruṣeṣu tattvasyāvighātān nityatvam| tato guṇeṣv api nityeṣu
analyzed: ubhayatra ca guṇa apuruṣeṣu tattvasya avighātāt nitya tvam tatas guṇeṣu api nityeṣu

original: pariṇāmo dṛṣṭa^ iti labdhālabdhaprayavasānatvaṃ sthitam||
analyzed: pariṇāmaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ iti labdha alabdha prayavasāna tvam sthitam

original: [367,10] tatra guṇadharmeṣu mahadādisu pariṇāmāparāntanirgrāhyaḥ kramo labdhaparyavasānaḥ śarīrādiṣv api| nityeṣu tu guṇeṣu dharmiṣv alabdhaparyavasānaḥ nityatvād eṣām| kūṭasthanityeṣu svarūpamātrapratiṣṭheṣu muktapuruṣeṣu svarūpāstitā krameṇa^ evānubhūyate|
analyzed: tatra guṇa dharmeṣu mahat ādisu pariṇāma apara anta nirgrāhyaḥ kramaḥ labdha paryavasānaḥ śarīra ādiṣu api nityeṣu tu guṇeṣu dharmiṣu alabdha paryavasānaḥ nitya tvāt eṣām kūṭastha nityeṣu svarūpa mātra pratiṣṭheṣu mukta puruṣeṣu svarūpa astitā krameṇa eva anubhūyate

original: tena muktapuruṣeṣv asann apy anubhavadāreṇa śabdapṛṣṭhenāstikriyām upādāya vikalpitaḥ ity alabdhaparyavasāna^ eva|
analyzed: tena mukta puruṣeṣu asān api anubhavadāreṇa śabda pṛṣṭhena astikriyām upādāya vikalpitaḥ iti alabdha paryavasānaḥ eva

original: paramārthataḥ puruṣeṣv apariṇāmitvān nāsti krama^ ity arthaḥ||
analyzed: paramārthataḥ puruṣeṣu apariṇāmi tvāt na asti kramaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: [367,16] athāsya saṃsārasya sthityā pradhānarūpeṇa gagtyā vikārātmanā dvayaṃ ca guṇātmakam iti guṇeṣu ca vartamānasyāsti kramaparisamāptiḥ na vā^ ity avacanīyam etat| asty eva^ ity avadhāraṇaṃ na śakyaṃ kartum| nāpi nāsti eva^ iti| kiṃ tu vibhajya kasyacid asti kasyāpi nāstīti vacanīyam eva||
analyzed: atha asya saṃsārasya sthityā pradhāna rūpeṇa gagtyā vikāra ātmanā dvayam ca guṇa ātmakam iti guṇeṣu ca vartamānasya asti krama parisamāptiḥ na vā iti avacanīyam etat asti eva iti avadhāraṇam na śakyam kartum na api na asti eva iti kim tu vibhajya kasyacid asti kasya api na asti iti vacanīyam eva

original: [367,20] katham asti praśna^ ekāntavacanīyaḥ apravibhajyāpi| yathā sarvo jāto mariṣyati^ ajñānī^ iti| nanu jñānavān api mariṣyaty eva| ucyate^ ajñasya hi maraṇm ity abhimānaḥ na jñāninaḥ| tathā ca^ uktam mithyā^ etad āhur mriyatīti mūḍhāḥ iti||
analyzed: katham asti praśnaḥ ekānta vacanīyaḥ a pravibhajya api yathā sarvaḥ jātaḥ mariṣyati ajñānī iti nanu jñānavān api mariṣyati eva ucyate ajñasya hi maraṇm iti abhimānaḥ na jñāninaḥ tathā ca uktam mithyā etat āhuḥ mriyati iti mūḍhāḥ iti

original: [367,24] atha sarvo mṛtvā janiṣyata^ iti vibhajya vacanīyam etat ekāntānupapatteḥ| katham pratyuditakhyātiḥ kṣīṇatṛṣṇaḥ kuśalo na janiṣyate^ itaraḥ ajñaḥ aniṣyate||
analyzed: atha sarvaḥ mṛtvā janiṣyate iti vibhajya vacanīyam etat ekānta anupapatteḥ katham pratyudita khyātiḥ kṣīṇa tṛṣṇaḥ kuśalaḥ na janiṣyate itaraḥ ajñaḥ aniṣyate

original: [368,14] tathā manuṣyajātiḥ śreyasī^ eva na^ eva vā^ ity avacanīyaḥ
analyzed: tathā manuṣya jātiḥ śreyasī eva naḥ eva vā iti avacanīyaḥ

original: praśnaḥ| pravibhajya tu vacanīya^ eva| katham paśūn uddiśya śreyasī bhavati| devān ṛṣīṃś cādhikṛtya na śreyasī bhavati||
analyzed: praśnaḥ pravibhajya tu vacanīyaḥ eva katham paśūn uddiśya śreyasī bhavati devān ṛṣīn ca adhikṛtya na śreyasī bhavati

original: [368,17] ayaṃ tv avacanīya^ evāpravibhajya sāmānyena praśnaḥ yathā saṃsāro 'yam antavān eva^ ity ananta^ eva^ iti vā| bandhamokṣānupapatteḥ|
analyzed: ayam tu avacanīyaḥ eva a pravibhajya sāmānyena praśnaḥ yathā saṃsāraḥ yam antavān eva iti anantaḥ eva iti vā bandha mokṣa anupapatteḥ

original: pravibhajya tu vacanīya^ eva| yathā kuśalasyāsti saṃsāracakraparisamāptir netarasya^ iti||
analyzed: pravibhajya tu vacanīyaḥ eva yathā kuśalasya asti saṃsāra cakra parisamāptiḥ na itarasya iti

original: [368,20] anyatarāvadhāraṇe doṣaḥ | saṃsāro 'ntavān evānanta^ eva^ iti vānyatarāvadhāraṇe doṣaḥ| tasmād avyākaraṇīya^ evāyaṃ sāmānenāpravibhajya praśnaḥ yathā sarvo mṛtvā janiṣyate^ iti^ evaṃ manuṣyajātiḥ śreyasyeveti ca| tasmāt suṣṭhūktaṃ kṛtārthānāṃ pariṇāmakramaparisamāptir guṇānām iti viśeṣaṇam ||4.33||
analyzed: anyatara avadhāraṇe doṣaḥ saṃsāraḥ ntavān eva anantaḥ eva iti vā anyatara avadhāraṇe doṣaḥ tasmāt avyākaraṇīyaḥ eva ayam praśnaḥ yathā sarvaḥ mṛtvā janiṣyate iti evam manuṣya jātiḥ śreyasī eva iti ca tasmāt suṣṭhu uktam kṛtārthānām pariṇāma krama parisamāptiḥ guṇānām iti viśeṣaṇam

original: [368,24] guṇādhikāraparisamāptau kaivalyam uktam| tatsvarūpam avadhāryate| kaivalyaṃ prati vipratipatteḥ| keṣāṃcid vijñānasantānasyātyantopaśamaḥ kaivalyam| keṣāṃ cit tu navānām ātmaguṇānāṃ buddhīcchādveṣaprayatnasukhaduḥkhadharmādharmasaṃskārāṇām ucchedenācetanasya dravyamātrasya puruṣasyāvasthānam| keṣāṃcid īśvarasāyujyam|
analyzed: guṇa adhikāra parisamāptau kaivalyam uktam tad svarūpam avadhāryate kaivalyam prati vipratipatteḥ keṣāṃcid vijñāna santānasya atyanta upaśamaḥ kaivalyam keṣāṃcid tu navānām ātma guṇānām buddhi icchā dveṣa prayatna sukha duḥkha dharma adharma saṃskārāṇām ucchedena acetanasya dravya mātrasya puruṣasya avasthānam keṣāṃcid īśvara sāyujyam

original: keṣāṃcit sarvajñatvādīśvaratulyadharmatvaprāptiḥ kaivalyam iti bhinnā matiḥ||
analyzed: keṣāṃcid sarvajña tvāt īśvara tulya dharma tva prāptiḥ kaivalyam iti bhinnā matiḥ

original: [369,9] ihāpi vipratipattipraṇodāya kaivalyasvarūpam avadhāryate puruṣārthaśūnyānāṃ guṇānāṃ yaḥ pratiprasavaḥ pratisaṃsargaḥ svakāraṇe pratyastamaya ity arthaḥ pāryakaraṇātmakatayāpariṇatānām tat kaivalyaṃ puruṣasya kevalatvaṃ guṇair abhiśrībhāva ity arthaḥ||
analyzed: iha api vipratipatti praṇodāya kaivalya svarūpam avadhāryate puruṣa artha śūnyānām guṇānām yaḥ pratiprasavaḥ pratisaṃsargaḥ sva kāraṇe prati astamayaḥ iti arthaḥ pārya karaṇa ātmaka tayā apariṇatānām tat kaivalyam puruṣasya kevala tvam guṇaiḥ abhiśrībhāvaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: [369,13] svarūpapratiṣṭhā vā citiśktir iti| buddhisattvānabhisaṃbandhinī yā puruṣasya citiśaktiḥ amiśrā kevalā tasyāḥ sadā tathā^ evāvasthānaṃ kevalāyāḥ bhāvaḥ kaivalyam||
analyzed: sva rūpa pratiṣṭhā vā citiśktiḥ iti buddhi sattva an abhisaṃbandhinī yā puruṣasya citi śaktiḥ amiśrā kevalā tasyāḥ sadā tathā eva avasthānam kevalāyāḥ bhāvaḥ kaivalyam

original: [369,16] nanu kaivalyasya^ ekatve kathaṃ vikalpaḥ kriyāyāṃ hi vikalpo na vastuni| vastu-svarūpasya bhedānupapatteḥ kaivalyam api vastu kathaṃ tadvikalpyata^ iti na^ eṣa doṣaḥ| nimittanaimittakayoḥ prabhedopapatteḥ nimittanaimittkabhedopacarito api vikalpo rūpatā sā kāryakaraṇātmakānāṃ
analyzed: nanu kaivalyasya eka tve katham vikalpaḥ kriyāyām hi vikalpaḥ na vastuni vastu svarūpasya bheda anupapatteḥ kaivalyam api vastu katham tat vikalpyate iti na eṣa doṣaḥ nimitta naimittakayoḥ prabheda upapatteḥ nimitta naimittka bheda upacaritaḥ api vikalpaḥ rūpatā sā kārya karaṇa ātmakānām

original: puruṣārthaśūnyānāṃ guṇānāṃ pratiasṃsargān nimittād apagacchatīti nimittam eva pratiprasavākhyaṃ kaivalyaśabdena^ upacaritaṃ pūrvam||
analyzed: puruṣa artha śūnyānām guṇānām prati a sṃsargāt nimittāt apagacchati iti nimittam eva pratiprasava ākhyam kaivalya śabdena upacaritam pūrvam

original: [396,21] dvitīyaṃ tu guṇapratiprasavanimittabhāvi yat svarūpāvasthānaṃ
analyzed: dvitīyam tu guṇa pratiprasava nimitta bhāvi yat svarūpa avasthānam

original: puruṣasya guṇair amiśritatayā tat kaivalyam iti viśeṣaḥ| guṇapuruṣāntarasvarūpatattvanirdhāraṇena tantrāntarīyatatvasvarūpanirākaraṇena ca kaivalyāntarāṇiniveditavyāni||
analyzed: puruṣasya guṇaiḥ amiśrita tayā tat kaivalyam iti viśeṣaḥ guṇa puruṣa antara svarūpa tattva nirdhāraṇena tantra antarīya tatva svarūpa nirākaraṇena ca kaivalya antarāṇi niveditavyāni

original: [396,24] tatra^ oṅkāro maṅgalārthaḥ prayuktaḥ parameśvaranāmāṅkitamastakatayā tantrapracayārthaṃ śāntyarthaṃ vā vedāraṇyakavad iti^ om iti||
analyzed: tatra oṅkāraḥ maṅgala arthaḥ prayuktaḥ parameśvara nāma aṅkita mastaka tayā tantra pracaya artham śānti artham vā veda āraṇyaka vat iti om iti

original: [370,1] oṅkāro yasya vaktā samacarat phalaiḥ karma yasmād aśeṣaṃ niṣkarmakleśapāko ghaṭayati sakalaṃ yaḥ phalena kriyāṇām| 370,3        īśānām īśvaro yaḥ sthitibhavanidhanaprakriyāṇāṃ vidhātā dhyāya naḥ śuklimānaṃ vyapanudatu tarāṃ kṛṣṇimānaṃ sa kṛṣṇaḥ||
analyzed: oṅkāraḥ yasya vaktā samacarat phalaiḥ karma yasmāt aśeṣam niṣkarma kleśa pākaḥ ghaṭayati sakalam yaḥ phalena kriyāṇām īśānām īśvaraḥ yaḥ sthiti bhava nidhana prakriyāṇām vidhātā dhyāya naḥ śuklimānam vyapanudatu tarām kṛṣṇimānam sa kṛṣṇaḥ

original: [370,5] yātrākṛtas trijagatāṃ yad^ acintyaśaktileśām daśāhur iha mīnamukhāvatārān| 370,9     kleśudbhavatrividhatāpaparamparārtāḥ taṃ nāganāthaśayanaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmaḥ||
analyzed: yātrā kṛtaḥ trijagatām yat acintya śakti leśām daśa āhuḥ iha mīna mukha avatārān kleśa udbhava trividha tāpa paramparā ārtāḥ tam nāga nātha śayanam śaraṇam vrajāmaḥ

original: [370,11] phaṇaratnaoghavidyoti [pṛthivī dyunabhodiśe| yogīndrāya
analyzed: phaṇa ratna ogha vidyoti pṛthivī dyu nabhaḥ diśe yogi indrāya

original: phaṇīndrāya tatpatañjalaye namaḥ||
analyzed: phaṇi indrāya tat patañjalaye namaḥ

original: [370,13] yogena cittasya padena vācāṃ malaṃ śarīrasya tu vaidyakena| yo 'pākarot taṃ pravaraṃ munīnāṃ patañjaliṃ prāñjalir ānato 'smi||
analyzed: yogena cittasya padena vācām malam śarīrasya tu vaidyakena upākarot tam pravaram munīnām patañjalim prāñjaliḥ ānataḥ smi

original: [370,15] sa jayati patañjalimuniḥ yena śreyo 'rthasārthasasyānām| vihito harṣas tāpatritayahṛtā dharmameghena||
analyzed: sa jayati patañjali muniḥ yena śreyaḥ ṛtha sārtha sasyānām vihitaḥ harṣaḥ tāpa tritaya hṛtā dharma meghena

original: [370,17] yas tatāna bhavamārgalaṅghināṃ kleśakarmamayadharmanuttaye| dharmamedhamukhayogatoyadam [taṃ patañjalim ṛṣiṃ praṇato 'smi]||
analyzed: yaḥ tatāna bhava mārga laṅghinām kleśa karma maya dharma nuttaye dharma medha mukha yoga toyadam tam patañjalim ṛṣim praṇataḥ smi

original: [370,19] vadanāhitapūrṇacandrakaṃ gurum īśānam abhūtibhūṣaṇam| praṇamāmy abhujaṅgasaṅgrahaṃ bhagavatpādam apūrvaśaṅkaram||
analyzed: vadana āhita pūrṇa candrakam gurum īśānam abhūtibhūṣaṇam praṇamāmi abhujaṅga saṅgraham bhagavat pādam apūrva śaṅkaram

original: [370,21] iti śrīgovandabhagavatpūjyapādaśiṣyasya
analyzed: iti śrī govanda bhagavat pūjya pāda śiṣyasya

analyzed: paramahaṃsa parivrājaka ācāryasya śrī śaṅkara bhagavataḥ kṛtau

original: pātañjalayogasūtra(śāstra)bhāṣyavivaraṇe caturthaḥ kaivalyapādaḥ||
analyzed: pātañjala yoga sūtra śāstra bhāṣya vivaraṇe caturthaḥ kaivalya pādaḥ

original: || samāptaṃ cedaṃ vivaraṇam||
analyzed: samāptam ca idam vivaraṇam
